title: ShowNow: Fine-Grained Speculative Streaming for Responsive World Models
comment: 23 pages, including appendix. Video examples provided as ancillary files
summary: Interactive world models must generate video continuously while responding promptly to user actions. Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path. We introduce ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework that uses computation available during playback to prepare action-conditioned futures before input arrives. Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions. We construct a matched multi-future dataset to train alternative continuations from a common state; shared-history tree execution and fused commitment make their preparation efficient. On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures. In ViZDoom, the complete ShowNow deployment reduces median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms relative to the native-block SolarWM-FT deployment. Matched-policy experiments reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09% (94%) and improve on-time responses to action changes. These results establish complementary roles for fine-grained commitment and advance preparation, with measured trade-offs in visual fidelity and long-horizon consistency. ShowNow turns playback-time computation into responsive visual interaction. Project: https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ShowNow：利用视频播放期间的空闲算力，预先准备多种动作条件下的后续片段，以单 latent 粒度的承诺决策配合共享历史树执行，在单张 H100 上实现 480p/16fps 的响应式世界模型流式生成，并显著降低输入到显示的延迟。

title: Reading, Not Adapting: Unlocking Frozen Visual Knowledge for AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Generalization to unseen image generators has driven efforts to adapt pretrained visual representations for detection. Yet recent findings show that vision foundation models already encode transferable detection knowledge, while further adaptation can impair generalization. This motivates a shift from backbone adaptation to knowledge readout. Conventional linear probing offers a direct way to read this knowledge but is limited to final-layer RGB features. Multi-cue detectors broaden the evidence base, but their designs introduce other tradeoffs: adaptation may compromise pretrained transferability, heterogeneous encoders complicate feature integration, and late fusion precludes intermediate cross-view interaction. To overcome these limitations, we propose ReMoT, a Mixture-of-Transformers-inspired framework that reads complementary knowledge from spatially aligned RGB and wavelet views within a fully frozen visual foundation. ReMoT employs staged joint attention to enable controlled local and global cross-view interaction, while learnable fusion queries progressively read complementary evidence across Transformer depth without writeback. ReMoT achieves 91.2% average accuracy across eight benchmark groups with 3,074 trainable parameters, attaining the highest overall average among the evaluated methods. These results support structured knowledge readout as a promising alternative to backbone adaptation. Code is available at https://github.com/yunncheng/ReMoT.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 AI 生成图像检测的跨生成器泛化，提出 ReMoT：在完全冻结的视觉基础模型中，通过分阶段联合注意力和可学习 fusion queries 从空间对齐的 RGB 与小波视图跨 Transformer 深度读取互补证据，仅用约 3 千个可训练参数，在八个基准组上平均准确率 91.2%。

title: Privileged On-Policy Distillation for Calibrated Alzheimer's Diagnosis With Missing Modalities
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging
summary: Alzheimer's disease is diagnosed from clinical, biospecimen and imaging evidence, but few patients undergo every test. Because these modalities are complementary, a missing one has many plausible values. Most existing methods leave it out or train on one estimate, so their classifier never sees its other values, and the estimate is never checked against the diagnosis. We address both gaps with on-policy distillation: the model fills in the missing modalities itself, and teachers with information available only in training grade these fills. Our method, Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers, draws several fills, one modality at a time. An imputation teacher that knows the diagnosis grades each step, bringing the outcome into the imputation as statistical practice recommends. A diagnosis teacher that sees all real modalities supplies a soft target. Trained on fills that vary, the model learns a confidence that reflects what the missing tests leave open, and it diagnoses from a single rollout. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative cohort, it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. On two external cohorts, it remains competitive in discrimination and, even after every method is recalibrated, its calibration error is level with the lowest on both. Added to three of these baselines, the teachers improve each of them. Our method offers a single, well-calibrated model for whatever combination of tests a patient has received.

AI.brief_summary: 提出基于 on-policy 蒸馏的缺失模态插补框架：模型逐步自行生成缺失模态的多种填充，由知晓诊断的插补教师逐步评分、全真实模态的诊断教师提供软目标，再从单次 rollout 给出诊断，并在 ADNI 及两个外部队列评估判别力与校准。

title: Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks
summary: The emerging field of weight space learning has demonstrated the potential to enable metanetworks, i.e. models that process neural network (NN) data, to support several steps of the machine learning lifecycle, from model optimisation to evaluation and adaptation. However, this potential has yet to materialise beyond small-scale MLPs or CNNs: most current models, including message-passing based graph metanetworks (GMNs), operate exclusively at the finest level of granularity, processing every neuron and weight of the input model. Their cost therefore scales with the number of parameters. Yet NNs are inherently organised hierarchically, with neurons forming layers and layers forming blocks and modules. Additionally, several of their properties, such as Lipschitz upper bounds and generalisation measures, are compositions of layer- and block-level quantities. To incorporate this inductive bias, we introduce Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks (H-GMNs), which leverage the input architecture's hierarchy to coarsen and refine the graph using permutation-symmetry-preserving pooling and un-pooling layers. Further, we extend H-GMNs to Transformers by introducing a graph construction that preserves permutation symmetries and enables multi-level pooling. Our evaluation includes new ResNet-18, ViT and varying ViT model zoos of up to 86M parameters, on tasks spanning model evaluation (an analytic Lipschitz bound proxy, generalisation and robustness prediction), testing (backdoor detection) and editing (pruning). Experimental results show that, compared to non-equivariant alternatives and flat GMNs, H-GMNs are markedly more sample-efficient, and their cost remains nearly constant as metanetwork depth grows, allowing deeper and more expressive processing where flat GMNs run out of memory, without compromising accuracy, which in certain cases considerably improves.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Hierarchical Graph Metanetworks，利用网络架构的层级结构，通过保持置换对称的池化与反池化对图进行粗化和细化，并扩展到 ResNet 与 ViT 权重空间任务。
AI.relevance_reason: 其多层级池化与对称性保持的图表示可能为 LVR 中分层 latent 工作区的状态组织、压缩和多尺度更新提供方法线索，但论文面向权重空间学习而非视觉推理，需核查可迁移性。

title: What Is a Theory Worth to an LLM Solver? Measuring, Inducing, and Merging Theories in Context
summary: Mathematicians solve problems faster when they know the right theory. We ask how much a stated theory is worth to a large language model (LLM) solver, and whether a model can write that theory itself. In a length-matched protocol, adding the right theory to the context of Qwen3-14B raises pass@1 on pattern waiting-time problems from 0.37 to 0.83 and cuts the median tokens of correct solutions from 10.2k to 6.3k, while worked examples of the same length do not help. The gain shrinks as the solver and its token budget grow (+0.46, +0.26, +0.07), and at a long budget it comes almost entirely from finishing within budget: solutions that finish are correct 98--100\% of the time in every condition. To separate induction from recall, we plant unpublished theorems in custom probability families and measure how much of the oracle theory's gain an induced theory recovers. A strong open model, required to explore the training problems with code before writing, recovers 60\% of the gain on one planted family, 48\% on a second, and almost none on a third, where it finds the right form but not the condition that makes the form computable. No single induced note is complete, but a strong model that merges several notes recovers 61\% of the gain on the classic family, above the best single note (47\%). Theories are worth the reasoning they save, and models can find their pieces before they can assemble them.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在长度匹配协议下测量给定“理论”对 Qwen3-14B 解概率题的正确率与 token 成本的影响，并用自造概率族检验模型能否自行归纳理论，以及合并多份不完整笔记能否恢复理论收益。

title: Reading Fine-Tuning Diffs Through Lenses: Model Diffing for Backdoor Detection
comment: 31 pages, 16 figures, 14 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/maxipetro/lens-diffing-backdoors
summary: We introduce a common scoring system based on token readouts to evaluate weight, activation and output-based model diffing methods for backdoor detection in fine-tuning processes. We also improve existing weight and activation based methods by incorporating the $J$-lens and its refinement, the $J{+}{+}$-lens. We test our setup in experiments where we compare a backdoored model with the base model from which it was fine-tuned. Our results show that incorporating the $J{+}{+}$-lens improves the weight-based method in all our settings, while the $J$-lens improves its ranks within single layers. The strongest single method is $ΔW J{+}{+}$, the weight difference decoded through the $J{+}{+}$-lens of the base model, which ranks a token naming the backdoor among its first ten tokens in 11 of our 12 settings. Moreover, we show that output and activation based methods such as ADL and Diff Mining can easily break if the backdoored model is penalised during fine-tuning for giving the backdoor's words probability on clean inputs, whereas the weight-based methods are not affected. Conversely, permuting the hidden units or training only the layers that read the residual stream hides the backdoor from the weight-based methods but not from ADL and Diff Mining. No single method resists both attacks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文建立基于 token readout 的统一评分体系，比较权重、激活与输出三类 model diffing 方法在微调后门检测中的表现，并用 J-lens、J++-lens 改进权重与激活方法，同时考察两类针对性规避攻击下的鲁棒性。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线无直接关联，但其用 lens 把权重差异与内部激活解码回 token 空间做对比的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态是否保留任务相关信息、以及微调训练如何改变这些表示的诊断线索。

title: When Every Rollout Fails: Splicing Learner-Conditioned Options into Long-Horizon Agent RL
summary: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards often yields all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks: every sampled trajectory receives zero reward, leaving group-relative methods without a reward-based policy gradient. A common remedy supplies complete solutions from a stronger model, but full trajectories are expensive and expose the learner to long off-policy histories. We introduce SPLICE, which constructs local training targets from failed current-policy trajectories online. For each all-fail group, a proposal model selects a splice point in a current-policy trajectory and generates several bounded options from that point. We estimate each option's value using repeated current-policy continuations, convert positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fit the current policy on the options. We evaluate SPLICE across two policy families on two long-horizon agent tasks, Software Engineering with SWE-bench Verified and Deep Research with BrowseComp-Plus. SPLICE outperforms GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines in all four settings, improving over GRPO by 2.8--9.8 percentage points. On initially failed SWE tasks, it raises GRPO's graduation rate by 10.8 percentage points. Further experiments show that SPLICE improves performance while reducing costly proposal-model computation.

AI.brief_summary: 针对长时程 agent RL 中整组采样全部失败、组相对策略梯度失效的问题，提出 SPLICE：在失败轨迹上选插入点，由提案模型生成若干受限选项，用当前策略多次续写估计选项价值，并把正价值选项转为局部加权训练目标来更新策略，在 SWE-bench Verified 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上优于 GRPO 和整轨迹引导基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 无视觉与 latent 状态研究，但其「在失败轨迹上定位可用片段、以多次续写估计局部价值再做贡献分配」的做法，可能为 LVR 中从失败推理轨迹中提取可训练片段、评估中间 latent 状态价值及缓解稀疏监督提供可核查的线索。

title: Generation as Reverse Encoding
summary: Pretrained visual representations accelerate generative learning by abstracting away appearance and spatial detail. Yet the same abstraction makes the return to pixels far harder, shifting much of the burden onto a larger decoder. We ask why the representation-to-pixel path should be learned independently when the encoder already provides a learned pixel-to-semantics path (the semantic encoding path). We introduce RevFlow, based on the principle of generation as reverse encoding. RevFlow uses intermediate representations of a frozen encoder as successive generative targets, first generating deep semantic representations, then shallow representations that retain appearance and spatial detail, before decoding to pixels. To learn these transitions without training a separate generator for each stage, we develop HyC-DiT, a unified generative model with a standard DiT backbone shared across stages and stage-specific condition injection. We further show that native matching in semantic representation space enables few-step generation. RevFlow accelerates both learning and sampling. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, RevFlow reaches 1.96 FID at 690M and 1.74 FID at 1.55B after only 5 training epochs. It also achieves 30.25 dB reconstruction PSNR with an 89M decoder. After a short native-matching adaptation phase, RevFlow-XL achieves 2.85 FID using a single sampling step in each stage. Our code repository is at https://github.com/ChengShiest/RevFlow

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RevFlow，把生成视为编码的逆向过程：以冻结视觉编码器的中间表示为逐级生成目标，先产生深层语义表示，再生成保留外观与空间细节的浅层表示，最后解码为像素；并用共享 DiT 骨干、分阶段条件注入的 HyC-DiT 统一各阶段，在语义表示空间做原生匹配以实现少步生成。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「深层语义—浅层细节」的分层表示目标与分阶段条件注入，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的分层监督、以及视觉细节驻留于哪一层内部状态提供可供核查的线索，但论文不涉及推理或证据使用。

title: CIRKDV2: Cross-Image Relational Knowledge Distillation with Contextual Modeling for Efficient Semantic Segmentation
summary: Existing Knowledge Distillation (KD) methods for semantic segmentation often guide the student to mimic the teacher's structured information generated from an individual image. However, they ignore the global semantic relations across various images that are valuable for KD. This paper proposes Cross-Image Relational KD V2 (CIRKDV2), which focuses on transferring structured pixel-to-pixel, pixel-to-region, and channel-to-channel relations modeled from global images in the dataset. A large teacher network often constructs a well-structured feature space in terms of global contextual dependencies. CIRKDV2 makes the student mimic the better structured semantic relations of the teacher, thus improving the feature representational capability. Beyond relational distillation, we further propose contextual feature distillation by using context aggregation to augment student pixel embeddings to match the semantic level with the teacher. This avoids the semantic gap problem between the teacher and student occurred in traditional feature distillation studies. Experimental results on Cityscapes, ADE20K, Pascal VOC, and COCO-Stuff-164K demonstrate that CIRKDV2 outperforms the state-of-the-art semantic segmentation distillation methods by large margins across various network architectures. Our code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/winycg/CIRKD.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 CIRKDV2，在语义分割知识蒸馏中让学生网络模仿教师从数据集全局图像建模的 pixel-to-pixel、pixel-to-region 与 channel-to-channel 结构化关系，并用上下文聚合对齐师生特征的语义层级。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨图像关系蒸馏与上下文聚合可作为训练期监督信号，可能用于约束 latent 状态中实体与区域关系的保留，但论文本身不涉及推理期状态生成，迁移线索需人工核查。

title: Split-RL: Local Conflict Resolution in Reinforcement Learning
comment: Published at The Fortieth Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies are often trained by mixing contradictory feedback that is localized in space and time. For example, a robot may prioritize speed in open areas versus precision in tight gaps. We introduce Split-RL, a Gradient Boosting Trees (GBT) algorithm that uses guidance labels to locally isolate these conflicting signals. Standard neural networks (NNs) lack the structural mechanism to do this, as their parameters share feedback from all sources. While GBT provides the inductive bias to explicitly partition the state-space per objective, standard tree-fitting procedures aggregate contradictory gradient signals before they reach the leaves. Split-RL leverages this bias to integrate guidance labels into tree construction, routing these updates into disjoint state-space regions and preventing signal interference. Such labels can arise from heuristics, sensor-derived events, or existing rule-based systems, allowing Split-RL to incorporate rule-derived structure while retaining a learned policy. We theoretically show how early gradient aggregation loses objective-specific information and characterize when the Split-RL score isolates conflicting updates. We focus on constrained RL and offline RL with mixed datasets, each balancing two objectives that conflict locally. Across domains with spatial, rare-event, and temporal conflicts, Split-RL consistently outperforms existing methods by meeting the episodic cost budget while maintaining competitive rewards. In offline settings, Split-RL localizes the tradeoff between imitation and policy improvement, outperforming other methods and achieving near-expert performance across varying dataset sizes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Split-RL：一种基于梯度提升树的强化学习算法，利用 guidance labels 参与树的构建，把来自不同目标的冲突梯度更新路由到不相交的状态空间区域，避免信号相互干扰；并在约束 RL 与离线混合数据设定下给出梯度早期聚合丢失目标信息的理论分析及实验验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以结构化划分隔离局部冲突的监督信号」这一思路，可能可供核查 LVR 训练中视觉证据与语言先验、推理与答案监督互相干扰时的贡献分配与梯度路由问题；但该文面向树模型与机器人/离线 RL，不涉及 latent 状态或多模态输入，迁移价值需阅读原文后判断。

title: HOG-WAM: Improving Visual Robustness through Future Gradient Prediction
summary: World-action models jointly predict future observations and actions, yet visual corruption can disrupt the resulting policies. We introduce HOG-WAM, which adds future Histograms of Oriented Gradients (HOG) as structural supervision derived directly from demonstration images. An auxiliary HOG diffusion transformer (DiT) module reads RGB features through asymmetric attention, allowing its objective to shape the visual representation used for control. The module is used only during training and removed at inference, preserving FastWAM's RGB-to-action architecture. We evaluate four controlled observation corruptions through a visual-corruption extension of RoboTwin, termed RoboTwin-Plus; HOG-WAM achieves the highest success among the compared policies under all four. Mixed-noise success increases from 78.86% to 82.86% relative to FastWAM, with comparable performance on clean scenes. On LIBERO Plus, overall success increases from 74.49% to 75.26%, with the largest gain under sensor noise, from 74.14% to 78.89%. Across four Franka tasks, average success increases from 40% to 59% under clean observations and from 17% to 24% under noisy observations. A representation ablation favors combining RGB observations with auxiliary HOG prediction over replacing RGB with HOG. These findings support future-gradient prediction as complementary supervision for visually robust control, with larger absolute gains on physical tasks than in simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/iPPLab/HOG-WAM.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 HOG-WAM，在机器人 world-action 模型训练时用未来 HOG 预测作为辅助监督，通过非对称注意力塑造视觉表示，并在推理时移除该模块，以提升视觉损坏下的控制鲁棒性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其训练期辅助监督直接作用于供控制使用的视觉表示，可能为 LVR 中保留视觉细节、抑制视觉旁路提供可核查线索；但研究的是机器人策略而非多模态推理，需较多迁移判断。

title: Transferring Architecture as an Optimization Prior
summary: Initialization determines the optimization "fate" of a model, going far beyond just setting the scale of its weights. It establishes a fundamental initial geometry over the input data, dictating certain aspects such as which examples are considered close and which representations gradient descent will naturally refine first. In this paper, we view the initial geometry of a network as an optimization prior and ask whether a network can change its optimization prior by referencing a completely different architecture. To investigate this question, we use an initialization procedure where a target network is aligned to the representational geometry of a randomly initialized guide network before any downstream training occurs. Crucially, alignment to the guide network cannot transfer learned features, never receives gradients, and does not use labels. We demonstrate that this cross-architecture transfer of "fate" benefits the target network in two key domains: (1) instilling the optimization benefits of depth into shallow networks by aligning them to deeper networks, and (2) transferring representational granularity by using fine-resolution networks to shape the geometry of networks with coarser representations. In both cases, the alignment results in improved downstream performance of the target network. Ultimately, this demonstrates that a model's architectural destiny can be decoupled from its physical structure and explicitly modified at initialization.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把网络初始化时的表示几何视为优化先验，在无标签、不传梯度、不迁移已学特征的条件下，让目标网络在训练前对齐一个随机初始化引导网络的表示几何，从而跨架构地把「深度收益」注入浅层网络、把细粒度表示能力传给粗粒度网络，并观察到下游性能提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接关系，但其「表示几何对齐＋深度/粒度迁移」可能提供可供核查的训练期线索：例如如何在不增加物理层深的情况下塑造 latent 状态的细节保留与计算分配，需读原文确认对齐对象与可迁移范围。

title: LoopTitan: What Does Parameter Revisit Buy a Mixture-of-Experts?
comment: 45 pages. Phase 1 technical report. Project page: https://datamllab.github.io/LoopTitan/ ; code: https://github.com/datamllab/LoopTitan ; models: https://huggingface.co/NaturalScale
summary: Looped Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures revisit layer parameters across depths. This design increases effective depth without adding parameters. Recent looped MoE studies report substantial gains over the standard MoE at matched budgets (parameters, FLOPs and KV cache). However, the reported gains still confound parameter revisit with other design choices, e.g., network shape and residual scale. We ask, what does parameter revisit itself buy? Using matched non-revisit controls, we find that parameter revisit itself buys almost nothing. We argue that revisit only offers a freedom an MoE already has, i.e., trading experts for depth (more layers, fewer experts each) at fixed parameters. First, at matched budgets, we decompose the state-of-the-art looped recipe, with revisit last. A non-revisit control retains all the gain. Most comes from network shape, and the rest from residual scale. We prove this scale acts as a lower learning rate on revisited layers. This helps under AdamW's uneven layer step sizes, but disappears under Muon, which keeps them nearly equal. Second, beyond matched budgets, we evaluate revisit by adding compute at fixed parameters. One extra visit gains more than doubling the experts. Yet without revisit, a deeper standard MoE at equal parameters and compute obtains 90.2% of that gain under Muon. Overall, gains come from network shape, the optimizer and added compute, which a standard MoE can adopt. Accordingly, we propose LoopTitan-Base as a stronger MoE baseline. Under Muon, it matches the strongest looped recipe without revisit or residual scale. We open-source LoopTitan and release 17 pretrained models (including LoopTitan-Base and the control). Our experiment record is public as GitHub issues, with predictions pre-registered and the full exploration history kept. This is our Phase 1 technical report, laying the foundation for follow-up studies.

title: Routeability Before Routing: Routeability Audit Protocol (RAP) and RouteabilityBench for Audited LLM Model Selection
summary: LLM routing aims to choose, for each prompt, which model in a portfolio is most likely to answer correctly. This only makes sense when the benchmark contains enough prompt-specific variation for different models to be best on different inputs. On coarse-scored LLM benchmarks, however, many models often tie for the best score, and the single best model may already leave little room for improvement. We therefore propose a routeability-first audit, instantiated as RAP and RouteabilityBench, a runnable claim-verification package. The audit is retrospective: it runs once the benchmark-portfolio score matrix exists and before router comparisons are interpreted as general evidence, rather than certifying a portfolio that has not yet been evaluated. Across four benchmarks and 66 LLMs, generic routing enhancements such as larger embedding sets, dimensionality reduction, selective abstention, clustering, and stronger regressors do not consistently outperform the single best model. The clearest positive evidence is concentrated in portfolio-dependent Omni-MATH settings, while GPQA, MMLU-Pro, and IFEval show different ways in which routing can remain hard or predictor-sensitive. Our practical recommendation is that routing gains should be reported together with routeability diagnostics, tied-best analysis, portfolio construction details, and family-corrected statistical tests.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出以「可路由性」为先的审计协议 RAP 与 RouteabilityBench：在已有 benchmark-模型得分矩阵上，先检查是否存在足够的样本级差异、并列最优与最优单模型上限，再解释路由收益；并在 4 个基准、66 个模型上检验多种路由增强手段。
AI.relevance_reason: 其并列最优分析、porfolio 构成披露与族校正检验，可供核查 LVR/VLM 中「latent 或 THINK-LOOK-STOP 带来的收益是否超出噪声与平局」这类贡献分配问题，属评价方法层面的借鉴线索，需核查可迁移性。

title: Beyond Feature Fusion: Sensor-Grounded Semantic-Spiking Learning for Robust Object Detection
summary: Underexposure weakens object details, and overexposure obscures boundaries. Spike cameras encode light into high-frequency binary streams. Long-window spike counts give stable appearance cues, while short observations reveal changes in firing rates from sparse measurements. We propose SPIRE, a sensor-grounded semantic-spiking framework for illumination-robust object detection from a single spike stream. SPIRE builds an appearance view from the full packet through detection-oriented illumination adaptation and constructs a sequence of cumulative views from progressively longer prefixes. Each prefix supplies a rate map, an edge map, and a rate difference that tracks changes as spikes accumulate. At selected scales, ANN features and spike-derived initialization jointly set the initial membrane potentials and firing thresholds, allowing semantic cues to shape the responses during temporal encoding. Local spike-count contrasts supervise both branches during training. The residual between measured and ANN-predicted contrasts combines with the spiking features to produce a bounded correction to the fused feature pyramid. On simulated VOC and COCO, SPIRE-D outperforms the strongest baseline by 4.00-5.50 AP50 points across the four under- and overexposure settings. On real PKU-Vidar-DVS recordings, it achieves 67.07 AP50 and 40.10 AP75. SPIRE-D also uses 50.4% fewer MACs than SPFD.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SPIRE，一种基于单路 spike 流的高动态范围目标检测框架：用全包数据构建外观视图，并按递增前缀生成累积视图与 rate/edge/差分图，以 ANN 特征与脉冲统计共同设定膜电位和阈值，再将实测与 ANN 预测对比度的残差作为有界校正注入融合特征金字塔。

title: Diffusion Steering via Adaptive Reward Estimation and Resampling
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate images that satisfy complex prompts, yet often produce images that omit requested objects, attributes, or relationships. We ask if models can more reliably generate text-aligned images by redistributing probability toward their more successful outcomes. We propose TrailMix, a training-free method that uses the base model's distribution of possible outcomes to adaptively guide generation toward better text alignment. During denoising, TrailMix generates inexpensive lookahead images from parallel trajectories (trails) and scores their alignment with the prompt using an external judge. The resulting distribution of reward scores allows us to estimate how strongly to steer generation toward a desired alignment level. We use these estimates to reweight and resample trajectories, favoring more promising outcomes. Across three text-to-image benchmarks, TrailMix outperforms existing baselines, with particularly strong gains on rare multi-object compositions. We further extend TrailMix to targeted image editing and introduce SEAM-Bench (Semantic Editing and Attribute Maintenance), a systematic benchmark evaluating whether semantic edits preserve other image content. Experiments on SEAM-Bench and existing benchmark PIE-Bench demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for controlled image editing. Our results show how a model's own possible outcomes can inform reliable and controllable generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TrailMix，一种免训练的文本到图像扩散引导方法：在去噪过程中并行展开廉价 lookahead 轨迹，用外部评判器按文本对齐打分，再据奖励分布估计引导强度并对轨迹重加权与重采样；另构建 SEAM-Bench 评估语义编辑的内容保持。
AI.relevance_reason: 任务属图像生成而非视觉推理，但「并行前瞻轨迹＋奖励分布估计划算/引导强度＋重采样」可能为 LVR 中的轨迹搜索、验证与动态停止提供可核查线索。

title: Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent: Self-Structuring Learning through Question Answering
summary: We consider the problem of constructing knowledge bases for applications based on large language models, in which the structure of a knowledge base determines how an application can retrieve and connect the information needed to answer a question. We study Self-Structuring Learning, a setting in which questions and expected answers guide the construction of a persistent knowledge base whose editable structure can be a graph schema or the organization of linked knowledge documents. We propose Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent, which diagnoses discrepancies between expected answers and responses obtained through the current knowledge base. At each round, the method proposes a structural edit, rebuilds the knowledge base, and adopts the edit when the learning loss decreases. The retained structure is evaluated on other questions about the same sources. By randomizing over candidate edits, we express the loss change of an edit as a derivative with respect to the probability of selecting it, and we evaluate joint edits as single candidates because their changes interact. Schema Descent instantiates the method for graph schemas. In experiments on large documents, each a bundle of research papers, the updated knowledge cards and graph schemas obtain higher mean Answer F1 on held-out generated questions than their initial structures, with schema gains in every document. On human questions, mean F1 rises for schemas and falls for cards: the updated structures serve the kind of question they were learned from.

AI.brief_summary: 研究以问答反馈自组织持久化知识库的结构，提出「Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent」：每轮基于期望答案与当前回答的差异提出结构编辑、重建知识库，损失下降则采纳，并在大文档与人类问题上评估图 schema 和知识卡片的更新效果。

title: From Prediction to Decision: Decision-Focused Fine-Tuning of Autoregressive Tabular Transformers for Cost-Sensitive Financial Events
summary: Autoregressive transformers trained on tokenized tabular event streams are a simple and strong baseline for predicting financial events such as fraud. Yet institutions do not act on probabilities; they act on decisions whose consequences are asymmetric and heteroscedastic: the cost of a missed high-value fraud and that of a wrongly declined small purchase are not the same. The standard bridge is post-hoc Bayes-optimal thresholding of calibrated probabilities under a cost matrix. We ask whether fine-tuning the model to the decision objective can do better. We fine-tune the same pretrained model so that its restricted softmax over label tokens (already a distribution over business actions) maximizes expected utility under an institution-specified, amount-scaled cost matrix. Because the reward is a known function of (action, outcome, amount) and the outcome is observed in the data, the expected-utility objective and its gradient are available in closed form. This is example-dependent cost-sensitive learning whose per-example loss is linear in the predicted probability, with no sampling, critics, or advantage estimation. A KL anchor to the pretrained model and an auxiliary language-modeling term preserve calibration and the generative event model. A sampled, group-normalized (GRPO-style) variant provides the extension point to trajectory-level rewards.

AI.brief_summary: 论文对预训练自回归表格 transformer 做决策导向微调，使标签 token 上的受限 softmax 在金额缩放的代价矩阵下直接最大化期望效用，并加入 KL 锚与辅助语言建模项以保持校准，另给出 GRPO 风格变体。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「直接用非对称效用目标训练输出分布、而非事后阈值」及 KL 锚定做法，可供核查是否能用于 LVR 的答案使用与停止决策训练，但该工作无视觉输入与 latent 状态，迁移效果未验证。

title: Focus Only on What's Important: Training-Free Focus Maps for Frozen Vision Transformers in Long-Video Object Segmentation
summary: Vision transformers are strong but costly image encoders for video object segmentation. Training-free token merging cuts compute uniformly across the frame, including on tracked objects. We give a frozen DINOv3 ViT inside a trained Cutie head a training-free focus map: full resolution where the segmenter expects its objects and coarser merging elsewhere. Protecting only the previous frame's mask works on short clips but fails on long videos, where fast motion pushes targets outside the margin and into background merging, locking in loss. Our policy instead takes the union of velocity-shifted and block-matched masks, runs a camera-compensated surprise check, delegates uncertain regions to the compared merger, and falls back to it when all objects are lost. On long videos (LVOS V2 valid, pre-specified protocol, three ViT-S seeds), it beats ALGM 0.98 by +2.76 J&F (95% object CI [+1.22,+4.44]; video-cluster [+0.99,+4.52]) at 16% fewer counted encoder FLOPs (0.385 vs. 0.459), sitting 1.0 J&F point below the dense-encoder baseline; at ViT-B the gain over ALGM 0.95 is +3.89 [+2.03,+5.87]. On DAVIS 2017 val it stays within -0.19 J&F of the dense encoder at ViT-S (-0.12 at ViT-B). Controls qualify the result: protecting only the previous mask under ALGM matches or exceeds accuracy at higher FLOPs (0.486), so expectation and surprise mainly reduce counted encoder compute. Practically, lower counted encoder compute did not reduce startup-inclusive mean Cutie step time on a 12-video LVOS sample (3%-8% lower in steady state; an equally engineered ALGM is faster at ViT-S and ViT-B). Section 5.2 separately examines a Cutie permanent-memory schedule and its latency and memory trade-offs. Code: https://github.com/boletoms/focused-cv

AI.brief_summary: 该论文为长视频目标分割中冻结的 DINOv3 ViT 设计免训练 focus map：在分割器预期的目标区域保留全分辨率，其余区域做更粗的 token 合并；策略取速度平移掩码与块匹配掩码的并集，加入相机补偿的 surprise 检查，不确定区域交由对比合并器处理并在目标全丢时回退。在 LVOS V2 上以更少编码 FLOPs 接近 dense 编码器基线，并报告实际延迟未明显下降。
AI.relevance_reason: token 合并与 focus map 实质决定哪些视觉细节留在内部状态，可对照 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与动态计算分配；其「计数 FLOPs 降低但端到端步时未降」的负结果也值得在评估 latent 计算收益时核查。

title: Towards Closing the Performance Gap in Cross-Modal Place Recognition
summary: Cross-modal place recognition (CMPR) matches natural language descriptions against databases of geo-tagged reference images, enabling localization without visual queries. Despite its potential for language-guided navigation, existing vision-language models lag far behind visual place recognition (VPR) baselines, even after task adaptation. Unlike general-purpose text-to-image retrieval, place recognition relies on subtle local cues to distinguish visually similar locations. We therefore hypothesize that a primary bottleneck in CMPR is capturing fine-grained correspondences between image regions and text details, which requires higher visual token granularity, strong text representation capacity, and local cross-modal matching. To address this challenge, we propose CrossPlace, a two-stage CMPR framework. Stage 1 performs global retrieval by pairing a jointly aligned DINOv2-B/14 visual backbone with a progressively fine-tuned BGE-Large text encoder, while Stage 2 refines top candidates using a lightweight token-level cross-attention reranker. Through systematic analysis, we isolate the drivers of retrieval accuracy and show that visual token density provides the largest performance improvement, while text encoder capacity and task fine-tuning offer complementary gains. To evaluate robustness under realistic conditions, we also extend CMPR evaluation to city-scale and severe weather and illumination settings. Across all existing and new benchmarks, CrossPlace achieves double-digit Recall@1 improvements over prior cross-modal methods, closes the gap to unimodal text retrieval, and narrows it to unimodal VPR. Code and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/oferidan1/CrossPlace

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究跨模态地点识别（用文本描述匹配地理标记图像），提出两阶段框架 CrossPlace：先以 DINOv2-B/14 与逐步微调的 BGE-Large 文本编码器做全局检索，再用轻量 token 级 cross-attention reranker 精化候选，并系统分析各因素贡献、将评测扩展到城市尺度与恶劣天气/光照条件。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「粗检索＋token 级局部匹配重排」的由粗到细证据筛选，以及视觉 token 密度是主要增益来源这一结论，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节保留量与「LOOK」式补充视觉证据的成本收益；但该工作仅做检索匹配、无推理状态生成或使用，与主线为间接方法线索。

title: Agentic LongLive: Asynchronous Agentic Memory for Long Video Generation
summary: Real-time autoregressive video generators stream minutes of video and accept new prompts on the fly, but struggle to keep people, objects, and places consistent over a long interactive story. Agent systems provide such memory for offline multi-shot generation, yet they read the whole script in advance, plan each shot before generating it, and regenerate failed shots, which a live stream does not allow. We present Agentic LongLive, an asynchronous agentic memory for long video generation. A memory agent on separate GPUs reads only the prompts revealed so far, never the generated video, and keeps a text state and evolving images for every person, object, and scene. From this entity memory it composes a global image and a per-shot memory image, which an auxiliary GPU prefills into the generator's attention sink before the next shot starts, and writes entity cards for the prompts that name them, so the video never waits for memory and video errors are not written back. A small language model, trained with reinforcement learning and an image reward calibrated using downstream video outcomes, decides what to remember before the next prompt is known. On LongStory-Online, a new benchmark of 25 stories (857 shots) revealed one shot at a time, Agentic LongLive improves persistent-state accuracy of LongLive-2.0, its base generator, by 26.3 points, protagonist identity by 44.9, and revisited-place consistency by 40.4, at about 1% extra generation time on H100. The full system streams faster than real time on one 8xB200 node with the generator in BF16 (34.3 FPS), keeps image quality stable over 14-minute stories, and improves identity on two MiniMax-H3 generators, one of which, LongLive-H3, also runs in real time with it. To our knowledge, it is the first real-time video generator with text and image memory kept by an LLM agent.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Agentic LongLive，用独立 GPU 上的异步记忆 agent 为实时自回归长视频生成维护人物、物体、场景的文本状态与演化图像，并将合成记忆图像预填进生成器 attention sink；一个小模型经强化学习、以用下游视频结果校准的图像奖励来决定「该记住什么」。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「选择写入记忆的内容」由下游结果校准奖励训练、且刻意不回写生成错误，可作为 LVR 中状态写入、证据筛选与信息保值的可供核查线索，但该工作面向视频生成，未涉及推理期 latent 状态本身。

title: High-Fidelity Image Matting with Pixel-Space Diffusion Transformers
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Project page: https://white-yc.github.io/pixelmatte/
summary: Diffusion models have shown strong potential for image matting by transferring generative priors learned from large-scale pretraining. However, existing approaches largely rely on latent diffusion models, whose compressed representations and VAE-based reconstruction introduce a mismatch with the high-frequency precision required for matting. We present PixelMatte, a framework that adapts pretrained pixel-space diffusion transformers for high-fidelity image matting. We show that strong image-conditioned matting capabilities can be acquired even from a pure text-to-image model without paired image-to-image pretraining. Our approach reuses the backbone's native patch embedding to jointly process the input image, trimap, and noisy alpha matte as spatially aligned tokens, enabling direct pixel-space prediction without additional condition encoders or adapters. With pixel-accurate synthetic supervision and real-image fine-tuning, PixelMatte predicts alpha mattes in a single forward pass. Two lightweight calibration modules, LayerShift and High-Pass Refiner, further improve regional opacity accuracy and boundary fidelity. Experiments across four benchmarks and two distinct pixel diffusion backbones demonstrate substantial improvements over existing methods, reducing SAD and gradient errors by 24-44% relative to RenderMatte on P3M-500-NP and AM-2K, while achieving competitive performance on AIM-500 and RenderMatte-2K. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of pixel-space generative priors for precision-sensitive image matting. Project page: https://white-yc.github.io/pixelmatte/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PixelMatte，将预训练像素空间扩散 Transformer 改造为单次前向完成图像抠图的框架：复用骨干原生 patch embedding 把输入图像、trimap 与噪声 alpha 作为空间对齐 token 联合处理，并加 LayerShift 与 High-Pass Refiner 两个轻量校准模块提升区域透明度与边缘精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「压缩 latent 与高频细节需求不匹配、改用像素空间表示」的论证及原生 patch token 直接注入视觉条件的做法，可供核查 LVR 中视觉细节是否在 latent 状态里坍缩、以及如何无损注入视觉证据。

title: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
summary: Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstream tasks such as classification and retrieval. While such benchmarks measure how useful a model is, they provide no insight into the biology it represents. We introduce BioScore, a benchmark that quantifies how well an image encoder captures cell identities, with spatial transcriptomics of the same tissue as the reference. A sparse autoencoder splits the encoder's patch embeddings into sparse features, which we cluster into a fixed number of groups. BioScore then measures, for each of 52 cell identities defined by marker genes, how specifically one group follows the identity's expression over the tissue. Because the autoencoder training is fully unsupervised, a match shows that the model represents the cell identity from the image alone. We score 8 pathology foundation models and 3 natural-image models. Every pathology model scores above every natural-image model (0.299--0.371 \vs 0.214--0.232), and paired tests separate three tiers among the pathology models. Unlike a supervised probe, BioScore needs no labels, builds its reference from the data and scores even from few sections, yet it ranks the encoders as a probe does. Its per-identity breakdown indicates which cell identities each encoder captures or misses.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BioScore：用稀疏自编码器把病理基础模型的 patch embedding 分解为稀疏特征并聚类为固定组，再以同一组织的空间转录组为参照，量化每个特征组与 52 种由 marker gene 定义的细胞身份的对应特异性，从而在无标签条件下比较 8 个病理模型与 3 个自然图像模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文用无监督稀疏特征分解检验编码器是否保留细粒度、任务相关的属性信息，其“表示中是否存在某类细节”的核查思路可供参考用于 LVR 中视觉细节是否留存于 latent 状态的诊断，但领域为病理图像且不涉及推理与状态更新，迁移需核查。

title: Context Scaling: A New Frontier of AI Scaling
comment: Author-revised preprint; journal version published in AI Plus; 20 pages, 3 figures, and 3 tables; position paper and narrative survey
summary: Many failures of deployed AI arise not from weak inference but from a mismatch between the state a task depends on and the context available when the system acts. Relevant user state, repository revisions, tool traces, sensor readings, or environment changes may be unavailable, distorted, or poorly selected. We call the effort to reduce this bottleneck context scaling. We frame a model as $P_θ(d\mid c)$ within a system governed by three budgets: training $B_θ$, decision-time $B_d$, and context-infrastructure $B_c$. Pretraining scaling invests in $θ$; decision-time scaling searches, refines, or verifies decisions under supplied context; context scaling improves the system's capacity to acquire, represent, deliver, evaluate, and persist deployment state for model use. The three programs interact, but only $B_c$ targets what the system can make available before a decision. This view makes the model-infrastructure pair the unit of analysis. We define effective-context value as a task- and intervention-dependent attribution, separate deployment state from model-visible context, and identify availability, fidelity, selection, and utilization failures. We then organize current mechanisms through a five-operation context lifecycle and propose controlled budget interventions and utility-cost curves for evaluation. The resulting agenda centers on grounded reporting, interaction-data and full-cost infrastructure, and safety and governance for persistent, adaptive systems.

AI.brief_summary: 这是一篇 position paper，提出「context scaling」框架：把模型视为 P_θ(d|c)，用训练、决策时与上下文基础设施三类预算刻画系统，将部署状态与模型可见上下文分离，把失效归为可用性、保真度、选择与利用四类，并以五项操作的上下文生命周期组织现有机制与评估方式。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「状态可得性与模型可见上下文分离」及选择/利用失效的分类，可能与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、视觉旁路导致的可用信息损失及评价设计形成概念呼应，可供核查；但论文不涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态生成。

title: AutoformBench: A Lean Formalization Benchmark for Advanced Mathematics
comment: First authors listed in randomized order
summary: AI systems are increasingly capable of producing machine-checked Lean proofs of advanced mathematical results. Real mathematical formalization, however, is not isolated theorem proving: it requires building the definitions and intermediate lemmas that connect a result to a formal library. Existing evaluations often provide isolated theorem statements in settings where much of this supporting theory is already available in Mathlib. We introduce AutoformBench, a benchmark of 341 Lean 4 formalization tasks drawn from 24 advanced mathematical sources. Lean-experienced mathematicians formalized and audited each target statement, leaving the corresponding Lean proof to the evaluated agent. Each problem is embedded in a broader mathematical development: agents receive the informal proof but must translate it into Lean while constructing the missing definitions, intermediate lemmas, and supporting infrastructure. We compare the performance of frontier models on these problems. We find a largely shared difficulty frontier: success depends less on mathematical domain than on models' ability to construct missing formal infrastructure. Data and code at https://github.com/facebookresearch/autoformbench

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AutoformBench，包含 341 个 Lean 4 形式化任务，来源为 24 个高等数学文本；由数学家人工撰写并审核目标命题，但把证明及缺失定义、中间引理等支撑结构留给被评模型构建，并比较前沿模型表现。

title: REI: Learning Ideation from Repository Evolution
summary: As AI systems become increasingly capable of executing and evaluating experiments, ideation is emerging as a bottleneck in automated scientific and engineering iteration. In many real-world domains, useful ideas are sparse and their validation is costly, making direct online exploration inefficient. We observe that repository evolution provides a scalable source of reusable technical experience: code changes record concrete technical hypotheses, while subsequent revisions, adoption, and reuse provide signals about their utility. Based on this observation, we propose REI, a Repository Evolution-driven Ideation framework that learns reusable ideation policies from repository evolution, injecting domain-specific technical experience into model parameters and reducing reliance on costly trial-and-error. We further identify a hidden failure mode in quality-driven ideation optimization: semantic diversity collapse. Although generated ideas can remain lexically diverse, they increasingly concentrate in a small number of dominant method families, limiting cross-task generalization and long-tail exploration. To address this problem, we introduce Semantic Prior Optimization and Debiasing (SPOD), a diversity-preserving alignment mechanism that makes method identity explicit, corrects category-level reward bias, and limits redundant accumulation within the same method family while retaining strong representatives. Experiments on public benchmarks and a real-world industrial setting demonstrate improvements in ideation quality, method diversity, cross-task generalization, and long-tail exploration.

AI.brief_summary: REI 从代码仓库演化中学习可复用的构思策略，把代码改动视为技术假设、后续修订与采用视为效用信号，将领域经验注入参数；并提出 SPOD 缓解质量优化下的「语义多样性坍缩」。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「语义多样性坍缩」诊断与类别级奖励去偏，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹监督收敛到少数主导模式、长尾探索不足的问题提供概念类比与可供核查的正则思路，但无视觉或多模态状态证据，需较多迁移判断。

title: Semantic Density Does Not Predict Agent-Memory Collapse
summary: Persistent textual memory can improve LLM agents, but repeated updates can erode task performance. We ask whether memory-store statistics warn before held-out accuracy declines. We registered mean pairwise cosine similarity ($ρ$) and 13 additional geometry, retrieval, and graph statistics on 805 snapshots from 13 memory methods across ALFWorld, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, and two ARC-AGI settings. These methods store trajectories, rules, workflows, strategies, or linked records, using selective retrieval or whole-store prompting. No such statistic reliably predicted early signs of task accuracy decline, and $ρ$ had zero median lead. With the checkpoint after peak accuracy as a secondary decline point, measures of highly similar pairs and nearest-neighbor crowding changed earlier but did not consistently outperform stored-item count. We trained classifiers on this corpus and applied them unchanged to PropWorld runs of up to 5,000 crafting tasks. They falsely flagged 56.9% of checkpoints from size-limited stores with stable accuracy and detected only 18% of checkpoints after task success fell to zero. Thus, global semantic density did not provide a reliable warning, while local crowding did not transfer consistently across memory designs. In these long-horizon runs, size-limited stores remained stable, while the sole failure arose when unbounded whole-store prompting exceeded model input capacity, which token growth predicted directly.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在13种记忆方法、805个快照上预注册检验平均两两余弦相似度及另外13种几何、检索与图统计量能否在留出任务准确率下降前发出预警，并把据此训练的分类器原样迁移到长达5000步的PropWorld运行；结果显示全局语义密度无预警能力，局部拥挤指标也不可跨设计迁移，唯一失败源于无界整体提示超出输入容量。

title: General-Purpose Decision Models for AI Configuration Tuning
summary: AI configuration tuning searches for settings that improve the performance of AI systems under a limited budget. Existing tuners use different sampling and search policies, making the choice of decision strategy central to both tuning quality and cost. We investigate whether general-purpose decision models can guide tuning, using Jev as a deployed representative that returns structured choices and numeric scores across diverse tasks. To assess where it helps, we compare its use as an optimizer, performance predictor, and region guider against conventional methods and a large language model (LLM) on eight AI tuning tasks. Conventional optimizers attain rank 1 in six of eight comparisons. Similarly, established predictors outperform Jev in seven. Through region guidance, however, it finds configurations with lower perplexity than those selected by the native tuner, offering a quality gain when additional decision time and API fees are acceptable. These findings yield actionable recommendations on selecting the decision role, retaining conventional predictors, and balancing tuning quality against cost.

AI.brief_summary: 研究通用决策模型（以 Jev 为代表）能否指导 AI 配置调参，在八项调参任务上比较其作为优化器、性能预测器与区域引导器相对传统方法和 LLM 的质量与成本。

title: How Many Samples Is RL Worth? Best-of-N versus RL Post-Training for Text-to-Image Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) on a reward that can be checked automatically has become a common last step in the training of text-to-image models. A simpler way to get more correct images is best-of-N: draw N images from the base model and keep the one that a picker prefers. We ask how many base model samples one RL sample is worth, and call this number the exchange rate. We measure it for Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium and its public Flow-GRPO checkpoint on 398 new prompts in the style of GenEval, the benchmark behind the RL reward, with human labels on every prompt and two automatic judges other than the reward. The answer depends on the prompt. Four fifths of the prompts do not ask for a position (for example, one object left of another). On these, the base model catches up: best-of-16 with an off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM) as the picker is about as good as one RL image. A person who looks through up to 3 base images finds a correct one as often as one RL image is correct. On the prompts that ask for a position, RL is far ahead: a person finds a correct image among 8 base images for only 52% of the prompts, against 92% for one RL image. Over all prompts, our primary test, which we fixed in advance, finds best-of-16 with the VLM picker 9.3 points behind one RL image when both automatic judges must pass an image. People see a smaller gap, 5.5 and 6.5 points in two checks. FLUX.1-dev shows a similar gap in the same test. RL also solves 20 prompts that the base model misses in 128 tries, and 1,024 tries recover half of them. The automatic judges are wrong in opposite directions: a detector-based judge like the reward, as used in our primary test, reports a larger gap than people see, and VLM judges report little or none. Comparisons of RL with best-of-N should therefore check the selected images by hand.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 398 个 GenEval 风格新 prompt 上，用人工标注与两个不同于奖励的自动评判器，比较 SD3.5 Medium 及其实验室 Flow-GRPO checkpoint 与 best-of-N 采样的「汇率」，即一张 RL 生成图相当于多少张基础模型采样图；结果显示该比值强烈依赖 prompt（是否含位置关系），且检测式与 VLM 式自动评判器偏差方向相反。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽是文生图研究，但其「推理期多采样+选择器」与「训练后收益」的可比量化框架及「自动评判器不可靠、需人工核验」的警示，可能可供核查 LVR 中 test-time 采样、验证器质量与训练投入之间的收益权衡，以及停止决策评价的偏差来源。

title: Sequential Testing on Complex and High Dimensional Data Streams Leveraging Unsupervised Model Errors
summary: We propose two general, distribution-free test statistics for binary Sequential Hypothesis Testing (SHT) and Sequential Change Point Detection (SCPD) respectively, in streaming environments where the data (e.g., network traffic metadata) are too complicated for the exact probabilistic modeling required by conventional likelihood ratio-driven tests. Our framework also addresses the challenge of information asymmetry, where data is available only from the null/pre-change regime and not from the alternative/post-change one such as zero-day attacks or emerging disease related regimes. The proposed statistics monitor the errors of a predictive or reconstructive machine learning model trained solely on null/pre-change data, relying on imperfect generalization (the model's performance will degrade when deployed on data from the alternative/post-change class). Under mild assumptions on the model's errors, we establish rigorous analytical guarantees: strict non-asymptotic error control for SHT, and explicit bounds on the Average Run Length (ARL) and the Expected Detection Delay (EDD) for SCPD. Extensive evaluations in target tracking, chaotic dynamical systems, and real-world network security datasets, demonstrate that our framework consistently satisfies prescribed constraints where existing algorithms succumb to inflated missed detections and/or false alarms. Finally, because our methods operate on scalar errors without requiring online retraining or kernel evaluations, they are highly scalable.

AI.brief_summary: 该文针对高维复杂数据流，提出两种无分布假设的顺序检验统计量，分别用于二元顺序假设检验与变点检测；其做法是监测仅在原假设/变点前数据上训练的预测或重构模型的误差，并在误差假设下给出非渐近错误控制及 ARL、EDD 界。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文把模型误差序列当作证据统计量并给出停止与检测的形式化保证，可能与 LVR 中「STOP」停止决策、证据累积及 latent 状态漂移的判定方式形成概念类比，可供核查；但其属统计顺序分析领域，未涉及多模态推理。

title: MonoQPM: Splitting Features into Concepts for Inherent Interpretability and Predictive Performance
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (10/2026). OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=8bQNRlFQhZ
summary: Alongside superposition, polysemanticity is one of the primary obstacles to achieving interpretable deep neural networks. While these phenomena are typically intrinsically linked, the Quadratic Programming Enhanced Model (QPM) naturally decouples them. By representing classes with a sparse binary assignment of very few features, QPM prevents superposition by design on its final features but still exhibits polysemanticity. However, measuring polysemanticity is an open problem. This work proposes a utility-focused approach to measuring polysemanticity by quantifying the decrease in interference-induced activation errors, which yields the practical utility of tighter prediction sets using Conformal Prediction (CP). We explicitly disentangle the polysemantic features of QPM into monosemantic concepts to create the Monosemantic QPM (MonoQPM). Because its features are disentangled, MonoQPM acts as a significantly more efficient Conformal Predictor. Additionally, we introduce CUBCars, a dataset providing ground truth information about shared concepts. Using this and other datasets, we demonstrate that polysemanticity emerges in QPM across all tested architectures, but is effectively alleviated by MonoQPM. For instance, MonoQPM guarantees 88% coverage using Adaptive Prediction Sets on ImageNet with just 66% of the frozen QPM's set size.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出以干扰导致的激活误差下降来度量 polysemanticity 的效用视角，并把 QPM 的多义特征拆分为单义概念构成 MonoQPM，从而在 Conformal Prediction 下获得更紧的预测集，同时发布带共享概念真值的 CUBCars 数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「概念级解耦＋干扰误差度量」或可作为诊断 latent 视觉状态是否叠加多义信息、以及视觉细节是否被混淆保留的观测手段，但与多模态推理无直接联系，可供核查。

title: CriticalScenes: Scalable Photorealistic Critical-Scenario Generation for Closed-Loop Driving Adaptation
summary: Safety-critical interactions are rare in recorded driving data, leaving end-to-end driving planners with limited exposure to evasive behaviour during training. This lack of critical supervision can lead to unsafe behaviour and, in rare instances, collisions. To address this gap, we introduce CriticalScenes, a reconstruction-based framework that transforms ordinary recorded driving scenes into photorealistic safety-critical interactions with corresponding collision-avoidance supervision. Across 53 reconstructed source scenes, 979 of 1,060 attempted interactions yield feasible threat trajectories (92.4\%), while the inserted threat actors remain detectable in more than 95\% of non-occluded observations within 5--35\,m. Experiments with two structurally different end-to-end planners show that the generated supervision improves critical-scenario planning, while closed-loop transfer varies across planner architectures. SparseDrive achieves a 46.5\% relative reduction in collision rate on an independent photorealistic closed-loop benchmark, whereas UniAD shows only a modest closed-loop improvement despite substantial open-loop gains. The results further highlight the importance of closed-loop evaluation, as improvements in open-loop trajectory prediction do not necessarily translate into equivalent safety gains.

AI.brief_summary: 提出重建式框架 CriticalScenes，将普通车载记录场景改造成逼真的安全关键交互并附带避撞监督，在 53 个源场景上生成 979 条可行威胁轨迹，并用两种结构不同的端到端规划器检验开放环与闭环迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 属较远的驾驶场景生成方向，但其「开放环轨迹指标提升未必转化为闭环安全收益、且迁移随架构而异」的结论，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理与训练监督的真实收益评价方式。

title: Change Partners at Every Layer: Balanced Random Regrouping for Model Merging
summary: Model merging combines fine-tuned experts into one model that serves many tasks without retraining, but merging many experts this way substantially reduces accuracy. Grouping offers a middle ground: at every layer or weight matrix, the $N$ experts are divided into $K<N$ groups, the experts in a group are merged into one shared module, and a task uses the module merged from its expert's group. Natural choices are to keep the same partners across layers or to group similar experts. Surprisingly, we find that randomly changing partners at every layer outperforms both. We call this Balanced Random Regrouping (BRR): it independently partitions the experts into $K$ equal-sized random groups at each layer (BRR-layer) or weight matrix (BRR-matrix) and merges each group with an existing method. With validation-selected merge scales, both BRR variants outperform reusing one grouping across layers in all 24 CLIP settings, by 1.0-6.8 points, and BRR-matrix also outperforms the similarity-based FlexMerge in every setting. A first-order analysis explains this gain. At each layer, merging a task's expert with its partners shifts the task's output features; when the partners are the same at every layer, these shifts tend to point in similar directions and add up, whereas with new partners at every layer they vary independently and add up less on average. A series of experiments supports this analysis, which further guides a grouping search that can outperform BRR.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究多专家模型合并中的分组策略：在每层或每个权重矩阵上把 N 个专家随机分成 K 个等大组并组内合并（BRR），发现在各层更换伙伴优于固定分组或按相似度分组，并给出一阶分析解释各层特征偏移的累积效应。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接关联，但「逐层独立打乱分组可削弱偏移同向累积」的分析框架，可能可供核查多步或循环 latent 更新中误差与状态漂移的累积问题，以及分层注入多样性的设计思路。

title: Understanding Failure Patterns in LLM-Based Mathematical Optimization Modeling
summary: Industrial optimization involves complex constraints, making optimization modeling difficult to automate. Large language models (LLMs) have been explored for generating optimization models from natural language, but their reliability in end-to-end settings remains limited, often producing non-executable, infeasible, or feasible but incorrect solutions. In this work, we study failure modes in LLM-based optimization modeling by decomposing the process into three components: mathematical reasoning, solver usage, and domain knowledge, and constructing datasets that target each aspect. Using these datasets, we analyze how different components relate to errors and find that they are associated with different types of failure, although these relationships are not always strong or consistent. Furthermore, while combining these components improves execution reliability, feasible but incorrect solutions remain the dominant failure mode, suggesting a remaining gap between executability and correctness. These findings highlight limitations of current dataset designs and suggest the importance of data that better capture constraint completeness and formulation accuracy to enhance reliability.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文把基于 LLM 的优化建模拆成数学推理、求解器使用和领域知识三部分，并构建对应数据集分析各自的失败类型，发现组合能力可提升可执行率，但「可执行却错误」仍是最主要失败模式。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按能力成分归因失败、并区分「形式可执行」与「实质正确」的评价思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态是否真被答案使用、轨迹形式正确却推理错误的诊断提供参照，但任务与视觉无关，需核查可迁移性。

title: The Marauder's Map: Bézier Manifolds Reveal Hidden Surfaces for Model Merging and Ensembling
summary: Neural circuits are famously more robust than deep networks. This is often explained through degeneracy, where structurally distinct configurations support the same function. However, real biological systems exhibit a more flexible form of degeneracy in which specialized circuits continually adapt towards new competencies through localized changes while preserving existing function. Deep learning studies degeneracy through mode connectivity, which connects same-task networks by low-loss curves, sheets, or volumes. However, the field lacks a counterpart to flexible degeneracy, which demands more than ordinary mode connectivity. Defining such an analogue requires asking whether many independently initialized models trained on distinct tasks can be connected by a high-dimensional region of multi-task solutions. We introduce $\textit{Nimbus}$, which learns a high-dimensional Bézier manifold connecting $N$ specialists, going beyond the one-dimensional paths and two-dimensional sheets of mode connectivity work. A naive parameterization would scale combinatorially with $N$, but $\textit{Nimbus}$ requires learning corrections of only 3 interaction orders, showing that the connecting manifold has surprisingly low complexity yet supports multi-task competencies. The resulting manifold forms a navigable "Marauder's Map" that connects specialist models through a shared geometry of competent solutions. Trained across vision and language domains, $\textit{Nimbus}$ produces manifolds that are functionally and locally weight-flat: ensembles sampled from them degrade more gracefully than baselines under input and weight perturbations, with the largest gains in NLL loss and calibration error. $\textit{Nimbus}$ supplies a deep learning interpretation of flexible degeneracy, recasting model connectivity from a low-dimensional path between distant solutions into a high-dimensional volume of nearby ones.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Nimbus，用只需少数低阶交互修正的高维 Bézier 流形连接多个独立训练的专家模型，并在其上采样集成，显示在输入与权重扰动下更平滑退化。
AI.relevance_reason: 权重空间的「可导航流形」与低阶交互参数化，可能为核查 VLM 推理中多能力专家（如 THINK/LOOK/STOP）的组合方式与表示几何提供类比线索，但其对象是参数空间而非推理期 latent 状态，联系较间接。

title: Synchronizing Cameras via 3D Object Relationships
summary: In this paper, we synchronize multiple videos of the same dynamic event through object relationships. Driven by dynamic reconstruction and novel view synthesis, many recent synchronization methods rely on pixel-level evidence, such as point correspondences across views or the photometric losses of a reconstructed scene. In dynamic scenes, however, fast motion and occlusions make the moving regions that carry much of the timing information hard to match across views. We thus propose to bring back the traditional wisdom that objects are reliable cues for global reasoning about cameras. Measured in 3D, the relationships between objects, such as the distance between two people, are stable across all views up to scale; they can serve as cues for alignment. To compare these relationships across cameras, we only need the identity of each object in every view, as the cues are relational. We obtain these identities by giving a vision-language model a few frames of every camera and prompting it to identify the objects in the scene. We then segment and track each identified object through every video with an open-vocabulary segmentor. To obtain the 3D locations of objects, we use a pretrained depth estimator. Where depth or segmentation fails, we complement these 3D cues with 2D motion from point tracks. Finally, we synchronize the cameras by finding the temporal offsets at which the cues of different cameras agree best, first for each camera pair and then for all cameras jointly with robust optimization. We evaluate our method on four standard benchmarks, outperforming the state of the art.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究多相机拍摄同一动态事件的时间同步：用 VLM 从少量帧中识别各视角中的物体，再由开放词表分割与跟踪、预训练深度与点轨迹得到 3D 关系线索，最后通过成对与联合鲁棒优化求解时间偏移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以跨视角稳定的物体级 3D 关系替代易受遮挡和快速运动干扰的像素级证据」的思路，可能与 LVR 中实体关系表示及视觉证据筛选、线索互补（深度/分割失效时改用 2D 运动）有概念联系，可供核查；但任务是相机同步，不涉及 latent 推理状态生成，联系较远。

title: BreathSplat: Grounding One Smooth Motion in the Breathing Phase for 4D Cone-Beam CT
summary: Four-dimensional cone-beam computed tomography (4D-CBCT) images the anatomy of a breathing patient, but sees each breathing phase from only a few angles. Breathing, however, is a smooth motion that repeats; it has a phase. Existing methods exploit this either by reconstructing the anatomy as a function of the breathing phase, often through bins, or by estimating smooth dynamic motions in time. Yet none of these grounds one smooth motion in the phase. We thus propose to share projections across breathing phases with splines. Specifically, we represent the 4D volume with dynamic Gaussians whose motion uses B-splines in space and time. We ground the motion state in the respiratory phase, which we read from well-studied conventional surrogates. Projections at the same phase in different breathing cycles then constrain the same anatomy and motion. On simulated lung scans, our method, BreathSplat, outperforms recent dynamic methods in reconstruction and motion accuracy, including those given the ground-truth phase. We further show qualitatively, on two real patient scans, that our method provides clearer reconstructions than the state of the art.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BreathSplat，用动态高斯表示 4D 体积、以 B 样条刻画时空平滑运动，并把运动状态锚定在从常规替代信号读出的呼吸相位上，使不同呼吸周期中同相位的投影共同约束同一解剖与运动，在模拟与真实肺部扫描上提升了重建与运动精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接联系，但「把随时间连续变化的状态锚定到外部相位变量、并让多次观测共同约束同一状态」这一做法，可能为 latent 推理状态的参数化与跨轨迹证据复用提供类比，可供核查。

title: Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge to Guide Continual Learning
comment: Published at fifth conference on lifelong learning agents
summary: The goal of continual learning (CL) is to adapt to new data (plasticity) while retaining the knowledge acquired from old data (stability). Existing methods are explicitly designed to focus on balancing stability and plasticity to mitigate the challenge of catastrophic forgetting while promoting learning. However, the impact of order and nature of samples from the new data that the network is trained on remains an under explored factor. We argue that a CL algorithm should have the ability to rank incoming samples in terms of their relationship with prior data and their effect on the learning process. In this work, we investigate if scoring and prioritizing incoming data based on their semantic relationships with the model's current knowledge can benefit CL. We propose SACK, short for Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge, a plug and play technique for continual learning methods. SACK dissects categorical knowledge of the model into fine-grained concepts, computes the relationships between previously learned concepts and new concepts in each experience, and uses this relationship knowledge for prioritizing new samples. Experiments across several types of CL methods (regularization, replay, and prompt based) in class incremental and task incremental settings demonstrate that integration of SACK not only improves accuracy and reduces forgetting but also handles long tail distribution, helps focus on semantically interpretable regions, and yields better calibrated and robust models compared to prior approaches.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 SACK，将模型的类别知识拆解为细粒度概念，计算旧概念与新概念之间的语义关系，并据此对每个经验中的样本打分排序，作为即插即用模块嵌入正则化、回放和 prompt 类持续学习方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按概念语义关系给训练样本排序」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理轨迹的训练顺序安排，或概念级表示相似度（内容与深度因素）的度量设计，但属较远领域，与 VLM 推理期状态生成无直接联系。

title: Partial Routing: Trace-Tuned Delegation for Resource-Efficient Agentic Workflows
summary: AI models vary enormously in capability and price. Model routing exploits this by sending easier tasks to cheaper models. However, a single agentic task often combines easy and difficult subtasks, making one model choice for the entire task inefficient. We introduce partial routing, which guides a frontier lead model to delegate suitable subtasks to a cheaper worker model. From both models' past runs, we identify recurring subtasks and measure each model's quality and cost on them. These measurements produce delegation guidance, with a parameter, $δ$, controlling how much is delegated. The lead decides when and what to delegate during execution, without training either model. On held-out tasks from ViBench and Terminal-Bench 4.0, partial routing achieves higher mean task performance than the lead alone and task-level routing. With $δ= 0.75$, it raises the lead's ViBench score from 70.2 to 78.5 at 19% lower cost, and its Terminal-Bench pass rate from 54% to 61% at similar cost. Giving the lead only the subtask breakdown, without a worker, also reduces cost on both benchmarks and raises the Terminal-Bench pass rate. These results show that analysis of past runs can support more efficient planning and more effective delegation, with little cost and implementation overhead.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 partial routing：从两个模型的历史运行中识别重复子任务并测其质量与成本，形成委派指引，由 lead 模型在执行中决定何时、把哪些子任务交给廉价 worker，并以 δ 控制委派比例，无需训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作按子任务粒度分配算力、用历史轨迹估计某段计算的成本收益，可能可供核查 LVR 中「何时 THINK/LOOK、何时停止」的分段预算与证据获取决策；但对象是模型选择而非 latent 状态本身，联系较间接。

title: ArtKit: Motion-Driven Re-Segmentation and Link Re-Generation for Articulated Objects from RGB-D Video
summary: An RGB-D camera that films an object being moved, often from one viewpoint, sees one side of it and how its parts move. We present ArtKit, which takes such a video as input to create an articulated model with complete parts, a kinematic tree, and typed joints. Our central idea is generating the hidden geometry and verifying it against what the camera sees. A generative part prior proposes complete, part-decomposed geometry based on the first frame. Point tracks, grouped into rigid trajectories, split and merge the generated parts into links. We then fit revolute and prismatic joints, with a visibility-aware energy ensuring that the articulated model explains the depth observed across the video. A rule checks against the video to choose between synchronous group fits and per-frame chain fits, so that one pipeline serves a diverse range of articulated objects, such as household items and robotic hands. Finally, we regenerate each link of the chosen fit as one part and keep it wherever it agrees better with the observations. We evaluate on Articulate-100 and on HArt, a new benchmark of 60 PartNet-Mobility objects and 8 robotic hands and grippers rendered as RGB-D videos with ground-truth parts and joints. ArtKit reduces the axis and part motion errors of the strongest baseline by more than half on the objects, as well as the axis error on the hands. ArtKit also runs on real recordings and generated videos.

AI.brief_summary: ArtKit 以单视角 RGB-D 视频为输入重建带完整部件、运动学树与关节类型的铰接物体：用生成式部件先验补全不可见几何，借点轨迹分组拆分合并为 link，再拟合旋转/平移关节，并用规则在多种拟合与逐 link 重生成结果间择优。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先提出候选几何、再用可见性加权的观测一致性验证与择优」的流程，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的视觉证据筛选与贡献判定提供概念参照，但该文属三维铰接重建，不涉及推理状态或答案生成，需核查借鉴价值。

title: Collaborative Language Models for Semantic IoT Data Processing: Validation through Zero-Shot Human Activity Recognition
summary: Internet of Things (IoT) systems generate low-level sensor observations that are not directly suitable for process analysis and must first be transformed into semantically meaningful events. This paper investigates collaborative language models as a zero-shot semantic abstraction layer for converting such observations into higher-level event and activity labels. We propose a five-stage workflow comprising semantic mapping, semantic aggregation, temporal and contextual aggregation, specialized reasoning, and final event abstraction. The resulting labels and contextual information can subsequently be represented as event records for downstream Process Mining (PM) tasks. The approach is evaluated through Human Activity Recognition on the CASAS Aruba smart home dataset using eleven workflow configurations. The experiments show that collaboration alone does not guarantee improved performance: general-purpose auxiliary SLMs can degrade recognition, whereas assigning complementary specialist roles leads to better results and allows a smaller final classifier to retain much of the performance of a larger model. The selected workflow achieves a macro F1 of 0.643 in the 1.5-day comparison and 0.567 (weighted F1 0.680) in a one-week evaluation. Although trained ML approaches remain more accurate on this dataset, the results demonstrate a different design point: modular semantic event abstraction using off-the-shelf models without task-specific parameter fine-tuning. The findings indicate that the structure of LM collaboration and task decomposition is more important than simply increasing the number of participating models.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出五阶段协作语言模型流程，将 IoT 原始传感器观测零样本抽象为事件与活动标签，并在 CASAS Aruba 上用十一种配置做人类活动识别评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 「低层观测→高层事件」的分级语义抽象，以及角色互补分工比模型数量更关键的结论，或可为 LVR 中视觉证据的分层筛选与多模块计算分配提供类比线索；但文中无 latent 状态、视觉证据获取或停止决策的直接证据，需核查。

title: Yet Another Concept Drift Benchmark? A Principled Framework for Evaluating Drift Detectors
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data
summary: Concept drift detection is a fundamental component of data stream learning, yet its empirical evaluation remains based on loosely defined protocols, ambiguous alarm semantics, and inconsistent metrics. We propose a principled benchmark grounded in an explicit formulation of drift observability and alarm semantics. Our framework introduces finite detection windows and repeated alarms, enabling a clear separation between detection accuracy, timeliness, and stability, and employs a reproducible observer to provide a controlled and interpretable performance signal. Building on this formulation, we define normalized evaluation metrics and a composite score addressing limitations of existing measures. We validate the framework through a large-scale stress-testing evaluation of 10 detectors across 9 learner configurations and 16 datasets.

title: Anatomy-Aware Pseudo-Labels and Homotopy-Annealed Hausdorff Supervision for Semi-Supervised Pancreas Segmentation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to WACV 2027 Workshops (FABRIC). \c{opyright} 2027 IEEE
summary: Confidence-gated co-training assumes that pseudo-label errors are uncertain and concentrated at organ boundaries. We argue that for pancreas CT, where the target organ is a single connected structure and detached fragments are anatomically implausible, the dominant failures arise at three levels: where the organ is, what its boundary should look like, and how a correct boundary is penalized. Anatomical Rectification relabels implausible fragments of a teacher prediction as confident background, without adding any loss or parameter; an audit confirms that its rejections are overwhelmingly detached hallucinations and that thin, tail-like slices are not eroded. Boundary Grafting transplants labelled surface regions with their annotation into unlabeled volumes, replacing unreliable boundary pseudo-labels with ground truth. The residual error is coherent surface displacement, weakly penalized by permutation-invariant Dice and cross-entropy losses. Homotopy-Annealed Hausdorff (HAH) supervision anneals a distance-weighted penalty from an annotation-anchored objective that is convex in the prediction to a Hausdorff surrogate, admitting the prediction-dependent distance term only after the predicted surface becomes reliable. On NIH pancreas CT, under the standard semi-supervised split, the full method reaches 84.60% Dice and 4.97 voxels 95HD, improving all four metrics over compared methods; on MSD Task07, 78.90% Dice and 4.19 voxels 95HD. We further contribute PanTS-SSL, a semi-supervised evaluation protocol derived from the public 9,901-case PanTS corpus, with a curated 1,015-volume main pool, labelled tiers of 50, 100 and 250 volumes, an 80-case tumor track, shift probes for acquisition and anatomy change, and a fixed 901-volume test set. On it, the method exceeds the co-training baseline at 100 labels, scales to 85.29% Dice at 250 labels, and reaches 85.50% Dice at 100 labels with HAH.
