title: Embodied-VGGT: Preserving Reliable Local Geometry for Long-Sequence Reconstruction
summary: Long sequence reconstruction must correct accumulated drift while preserving locally consistent geometry. In robotics and autonomous driving, embodied acquisition provides recurring platform- environment geometry and repeated observations of scene structure and platform motion. We present Embodied-VGGT, which exploits these cues to establish reliable local relationships and selectively preserve them during global refinement. Memory-Augmented Grounded Chunks (MAGC) builds on Scal3R's global context memory and uses relative scale references derived from predicted ground geometry to regularize test-time memory updates, encouraging cross-chunk consistency while limiting changes to reliable local geometry. Superpoint Alignment (SA) and Cross-Loop Optimization (CL) jointly address the robust establishment and preservation of geometric relationships. SA balances ground and non-ground evidence across spatial regions to estimate inter-chunk translation. CL uses geometric and motion consistency across interleaved windows to select coherent chunk groups, each receiving a shared Sim(3) correction that preserves its internal relative transformations during global optimization. Experiments on five public driving benchmarks demonstrate consistent and substantial improvements in long sequence reconstruction. On KITTI Odometry, Embodied-VGGT achieves a mean absolute trajectory error of 7.30 m and a Chamfer distance of 2.67 m, reducing these errors by 46.8% and 23.3% compared with the state-of-the-art baseline under same evaluation protocol. To facilitate reproducibility, we released our code: https://github.com/Ang-Sheep/Embodied-VGGT.

AI.brief_summary: 面向长序列三维重建中的漂移累积问题，提出 Embodied-VGGT：利用地面几何导出的相对尺度约束在测试时更新全局记忆，并通过超点对齐与跨循环优化分组保持可靠的局部几何关系，在五个驾驶基准上降低轨迹与重建误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属几何重建而非 VLM 推理，但其「测试时记忆更新的可靠性约束」与「按一致性筛选证据并保留可信局部状态」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新、缓存与视觉证据筛选提供类比线索，需核查其约束构造是否可脱离几何假设。

title: PatternMiner: Automated Mathematical Discovery Through LLM-Guided Training and Interpretation of Small Models
comment: 46 pages. Code and experiment records are available at https://github.com/uw-math-ai/PatternMiner. Comments welcome!
summary: There are several approaches to AI-driven mathematical discovery. One of these involves the use of large language models (LLMs) to resolve well-specified conjectures via text-based reasoning, while another uses narrow models and interpretability for more open-ended, human-in-the-loop exploration using object-based mathematical data. The latter is limited in its ability to move beyond simple empirical pattern detection while the former is not well-designed for direct, open-ended exploration of large mathematical datasets. In this paper we introduce PatternMiner, a system that combines these two paradigms. In PatternMiner, an LLM agent generates mathematical datasets based on an initial broad question, trains narrow machine learning models on them, uses interpretability techniques to extract patterns from these trained models, and uses these patterns to formulate conjectures. Once an initial conjecture has been formulated, PatternMiner instructs the agent to search for counterexamples using calls to mathematical software. If a set of counterexamples can be found, these are used as feedback for conjecture refinement or another round of training and interpretability. The conjecture progressively evolves through this iterative sequence with the agent allowed to try to prove it at any point. We describe the results of applying PatternMiner to five well-known positivity problems in algebraic combinatorics. PatternMiner proves several new theorems related to Schubert positivity and projection, a character-row evaluation formula, a restricted version of the Kazhdan--Lusztig combinatorial invariance conjecture, and Schur positivity for a family of immanant coefficients. We end by analyzing the most common routes to conjecture generation that are used by PatternMiner in our case studies as well as documenting the most common failure modes.

AI.brief_summary: PatternMiner 将 LLM 智能体与窄模型训练、可解释性分析结合，构成自动数学发现流程：由智能体按初始问题生成数据集、训练小模型并抽取模式以形成猜想，再用数学软件搜索反例，据反馈迭代修猜想或重新训练，并在代数组合学五个正性问题上得到新结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「训练窄模型后从内部表示抽取模式、以反例反馈驱动猜想修正」的闭环，可能为 LVR 中 latent 内容的可解释读取、证据式验证与停止决策提供概念参照，但非视觉多模态工作，需核查可迁移性。

title: geo-eval-harness: An Evaluation Harness for Geospatial Foundation Models
summary: Geospatial foundation model (GFM) research papers are plagued by inconsistent evaluation settings (e.g., different pre-processing and probes), making it difficult to separate performance from evaluation choices. We propose geo-eval-harness}, an open-source framework for controlled model comparisons. We use this harness to evaluate 100 GFMs and general vision models on 6 classification and 14 segmentation datasets, using multiple probes on frozen or low-rank-adapted encoders. We show that under controlled evaluation, general vision backbones are competitive on RGB classification and high-resolution segmentation, but GFMs shine on multispectral tasks. When we compare any two of the top-ten classification models on a single dataset, their 95% confidence intervals overlap 73% of the time. We show that bigger models are not always better: inference FLOPs correlate weakly with segmentation performance. Moreover, translating inference compute into large-area mapping workloads shows how small accuracy differences have outsized deployment cost differences: with frozen encoders on SpaceNet2, a 0.9-point mIoU difference corresponds to 5.9x the compute and days of additional projected GPU time. Our findings stress the importance of comparing models under explicit and fixed settings, and reporting uncertainty and deployment compute alongside accuracy. Our geo-eval-harness makes controlled experiments easy, fast, and fully reproducible. We release the code, configurations, and results at https://github.com/torchgeo/geo-eval-harness.

AI.brief_summary: 提出开源框架 geo-eval-harness，在固定预处理与探针设置下比较 100 个地理空间与通用视觉基础模型在 6 个分类和 14 个分割数据集上的表现，并并列报告置信区间与部署算力成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 不涉及多模态推理状态，但其「固定设置可比、并列报告不确定性与实际算力」的评测范式，可能可供核查 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的收益—成本核算与结论稳健性。

title: ScaleCurve: From Constant Scale to Consistent Motion for World-Space Human Mesh Recovery
summary: World-space human mesh recovery can lose spatial consistency even when camera-space body estimates are accurate. A single sequence-wide scale resolves global scale ambiguity but cannot correct local scale distortion along a reconstructed camera path. We present ScaleCurve, a framework that estimates time-varying metric corrections from human-ground geometry. We construct scale observations by comparing predicted foot geometry with locally fitted ground planes. Joint temporal optimization downweights inconsistent observations and couples neighboring scale estimates, allowing calibration to adapt along the camera path without freely following measurement noise. We scale camera translation increments and integrate them into a calibrated trajectory. With this camera fixed, we refine the lifted body motion using 2D image evidence and pretrained 3D dynamics, while restricting global trajectory rescaling. ScaleCurve achieves state-of-the-art performance on most evaluated metrics on both EMDB-2 and SLOPER4D. Consistent gains across three HMR backbones demonstrate its compatibility with diverse body estimates without retraining. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ScaleCurve：从人体与地面几何构造尺度观测，用联合时序优化估计沿相机路径变化的度量校正，降权不一致观测并耦合相邻尺度，再据此缩放相机平移增量并细化人体运动，在 EMDB-2 与 SLOPER4D 多数指标上达到 SOTA。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文属世界坐标人体网格恢复，并不研究 VLM 推理；但其由视觉证据估计并时序平滑隐状态、抑制噪声观测的思路，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态更新提供可供核查的类比线索。

title: Manga Page Parser: Comprehensive Visual Parsing through Local Story Understanding
summary: Understanding manga requires connecting who appears and who speaks with the events, character states, and relationships that unfold across panels. We study manga visual parsing through local story understanding: analyzing each double-page spread independently to capture and organize its story information in a reusable structured representation. We propose MangaParser, an agentic reading framework that jointly performs character clustering, speaker diarization, and speaker-to-character binding within a shared multimodal conversation, without additional training or fine-tuning. The agent uses structured story memory to guide character and speaker identification, inspecting relevant image regions when uncertain and refining its predictions and story records together as evidence accumulates. Quantitative evaluations show that our parser substantially outperforms manga-specific models across multiple backbones. Parsing examples illustrate how a unified representation links the character and speaker predictions with narrative content and supporting evidence. We further test reusability through story question answering using outputs generated before the questions are provided. The results confirm output reusability, offering a foundation for manga translation, content retrieval, and question answering.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 MangaParser，一个无需训练的 agentic 阅读框架，在同一多模态对话中联合完成角色聚类、说话人分离与说话人—角色绑定，并借助结构化故事记忆指导识别、在不确定时局部重看图像区域，最后用故事问答检验输出的可复用性。
AI.relevance_reason: 漫画解析本身不涉及 latent 推理，但其「结构化记忆作为可复用中间状态」与「不确定时回看局部证据」的做法，可能为 LVR 的外部推理状态表示与证据筛选、停止决策提供概念参照，值得核查。

title: CARROT: Competitive Adaptive Graph Clustering via Semi-Relaxed Optimal Transport
summary: Deep graph clustering (DGC) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for unsupervised attributed graph clustering. However, existing methods often struggle with two practical challenges encountered in real-world applications: the number of clusters $K$ is unknown a priori, and cluster sizes are frequently highly imbalanced. Methods relying on a pre-specified $K$ may fail to recover the underlying clustering structure when $K$ is misspecified, while many approaches implicitly favor balanced partitions, hindering the discovery of minority clusters. We propose CARROT, a Competitive Adaptive gRaph clustering framework via semi-Relaxed Optimal Transport, which introduces semi-relaxed optimal transport into deep graph clustering to jointly address both challenges. CARROT first pre-trains node embeddings to establish a meaningful embedding space, and then jointly optimizes embeddings and cluster assignments through an Adaptive Clustering Mechanism. The mechanism combines semi-relaxed optimal transport to adapt cluster capacities to the underlying data, a competition loss to concentrate mass onto well-supported cluster prototypes, thereby starving degenerate ones, and hard pruning to progressively eliminate them. Extensive experiments on five public benchmarks demonstrate that CARROT achieves state-of-the-art NMI and ARI, accurately recovers the number of clusters without supervision, and faithfully preserves size-imbalanced community structures.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CARROT 深度图聚类框架，用半松弛最优传输自适应簇容量，配合竞争损失与硬剪枝逐步淘汰退化原型，在簇数未知且规模不均衡时同时优化嵌入与簇分配。
AI.relevance_reason: 「竞争+剪枝」淘汰退化原型、无监督确定有效槽位数的机制，可能可供核查能否迁移到 LVR 中 latent 状态或槽位数量的自适应分配与无效状态抑制。

title: Counter-DECEIVR: Counterfactual Explanations for Deepfake Detectors using Detector-Guided Rectified Flow Inversion
summary: Deep-learning-generated media are increasingly passed off as real, driving an arms race between image generators and deepfake detectors. Trust in the latter is limited by their often black-box nature; and, while region-based explanations can sometimes be extracted, these become less useful as generation quality improves. Counterfactual examples, which show the minimal change that flips a detector's decision, reveal what evidence drives a verdict, helping analysts decide whether to trust it. This work introduces Counter-DECEIVR (DEtector-guided reCtifiEd flow InVeRsion for counterfactuals), a novel training-free framework that generates counterfactual examples. Counter-DECEIVR steers latents in the velocity field of a rectified flow model using gradients from off-the-shelf deepfake detectors, without training a generator or adapting the detector; unlike prior methods, it requires no per-instance or per-detector fitting and no diffusion training on the target data. It also leverages the detector's explanation maps to concentrate editing to salient regions, turning low-level feature importance into localised counterfactual edits. A single parameter controls the strength of the edits. Across two deepfake detectors and two widely used forensics datasets, Counter-DECEIVR outperforms prior counterfactual generation methods, including training-based ones. Code will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出免训练的 Counter-DECEIVR：用现成 deepfake 检测器的梯度在 rectified flow 速度场中引导 latent 反演，并借检测器的解释图把编辑集中在显著区域，生成能翻转检测判定的最小反事实样本。
AI.relevance_reason: 「最小改动翻转判定」的反事实思路可为核查视觉证据对结论的因果作用提供评价视角，其梯度引导的 latent 编辑与显著图局部化也可能供核查视觉证据筛选与编辑式干预，但属较远领域，需判断可迁移性。

title: Feature Engineered Reinforcement Learning for S-pair Selection in Buchberger's Algorithm
summary: Selecting the order in which to process S-pairs is a crucial decision in Buchberger's algorithm for computing Groebner bases: this choice can change the cost by orders of magnitude. Recent work has shown that reinforcement learning agents viewing exponent vectors of the polynomials outperform classical heuristics on binomial ideals. We extend this line of work to general polynomial ideals by using statistical features. We introduce a 17-dimensional feature vector to describe a polynomial and use PPO to train policies on five distributions of random ideals. We find that using S-polynomial features significantly outperforms S-pair features on all five distributions. The new policies also outperform the retrained RL baseline on all five distributions, reducing algorithmic work by 41--53\% relative to the degree heuristic on four distributions where learning helps. The additional cost of the feature engineering means that wall-clock cost remains similar to the baseline, but our new approach benefits from easier transfer to unseen distributions.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在 Buchberger 算法中用 17 维统计特征描述多项式，以 PPO 训练策略选择 S-pair 的处理顺序，并在五类随机理想分布上比较 S-polynomial 特征与 S-pair 特征的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心发现是「表示何种状态信息」比策略本身更左右收益，这与 LVR 中内部状态应保留哪些任务必要信息的表示问题可能相通，可作为状态抽象的旁证线索供核查；但该文属符号计算、不含视觉或多模态成分，迁移性需自行判断。

title: Exploring the Design Factors of Pixel-space Diffusion
summary: In this paper, we introduce EiT by exploring the key design factors of pixel-space diffusion from three perspectives: model architecture, representation, and frequency domain. Inspired by Denoising Autoencoders (DAE) which perform denoising through a bottleneck, we construct a U-shaped pixel diffusion transformer that performs explicit compression along the channel dimension. In terms of representation, we find that both pixel and latent diffusion transformers exhibit a three-stage representation dynamics across layers and timesteps: denoising/local feature expansion, basis lift-up, and posterior projection. Moreover, earlier denoising and a longer basis lift-up stage are associated with better generation, which EiT naturally achieves through its channel bottleneck and increased network depth. From the frequency perspective, we establish the equivalence between pixel-space and frequency-space diffusion when keeping the network operating in pixel space. On ImageNet $256\times256$ and $512\times512$, EiT consistently outperforms JiT (Just image Transformers) in generation quality. Specifically, our EiT achieves better FID than JiT: 1.61 vs. 1.85 at $256\times256$, and 1.73 vs. 1.99 at $512\times512$. Remarkably, EiT can be seamlessly applied to video pixel diffusion by simply extending the patch size to temporal dimension and outperforms video latent diffusion in FVD evaluated on Kinetics-600 (resolution 256), under comparable total network parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/forever208/EiT

AI.brief_summary: 论文从模型架构、表征与频域三个角度考察像素空间扩散的设计因素，构建在通道维度显式压缩的 U 型像素扩散 Transformer（EiT），并发现像素与 latent 扩散 Transformer 均呈现「去噪/局部特征扩张—基底抬升—后验投影」的三阶段逐层表征动力学，在 ImageNet 与视频生成上验证效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其通道瓶颈压缩与三阶段表征动力学的分析，可供核查 LVR 中内部状态如何保留视觉细节、何时发生信息坍缩，以及瓶颈深度与表示几何的度量方式；但任务目标是图像生成，与 VLM 推理决策的联系仍需人工判断。

title: SysBio-SR: Benchmarking Symbolic Regression for Trajectory Fidelity and Mechanism Recovery in Systems Biology
summary: Symbolic regression seeks to discover interpretable governing equations for dynamical systems from data. In systems biology, however, accurately reproducing system trajectories does not necessarily imply recovery of the underlying reaction mechanisms. Existing benchmarks evaluate numerical accuracy, expression complexity, or equation-level similarity, but not agreement between recovered reactions and reference mechanisms in biological systems. We introduce SysBio-SR, a benchmark of 198 literature-based biological ODE systems with reaction annotations spanning mass action, Michaelis--Menten, Hill, and complex kinetics. Trajectory fidelity is evaluated across all systems under in-distribution reconstruction and out-of-distribution (OOD) extrapolation, while mechanism recovery is assessed on the subset of 161 systems. We evaluate trajectory fidelity across 11 symbolic-discovery methods and assess mechanism recovery for three reaction-based methods. Joint analysis across systems highlights how severely trajectory-based evaluation overestimates true mechanism recovery. Motivated by these findings, we develop KineSelect, a framework that searches candidate reaction topologies under biologically grounded kinetic laws to select optimal mechanisms that balance trajectory fidelity with structural parsimony. Compared with the strongest baseline, KineSelect improves aggregate OOD extrapolation \(R^2\) by 19.2\% and overall reaction F1 score by 14.3\%.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 SysBio-SR 基准，用 198 个带反应标注的生物学 ODE 系统同时评估符号回归的轨迹拟合与机制还原，并据此提出 KineSelect，在生物合理动力学法则下搜索兼顾拟合与结构简约的反应拓扑。
AI.relevance_reason: 「轨迹拟合好却高估机制还原」的诊断思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中答案正确性是否高估了内部 latent 状态真正承载的推理机制；其候选结构搜索与简约性取舍也可能类比 latent 假设的搜索与验证。

title: Detectable by Design: Learning a Continuous 3D Saliency Field from 2D Detector Responses
summary:
The 3D points kept in a map decide whether a camera can be localized against it, and this choice matters more as the map becomes sparser. Existing 3D keypoint detectors usually define saliency by semantics, repeatability, reconstruction or descriptor matchability. None of these definitions asks whether a point will actually be detected in an image, and as a result most of the points they select are not detected again in images.
  In this paper, we define 3D saliency as image detectability: the response of a 2D interest-point detector at a surface point, aggregated over all views in which the point is visible. We propose DetField, a continuous field over 3D space that takes a point cloud as input and predicts detectability at any location around it. The supervision is the response of a 2D detector, back-projected from images onto the point cloud. Multi-scale curvature invariants are passed to the decoder at every query point, bypassing the voxel pooling of the encoder.
  In a localization benchmark that isolates the choice of 3D points, DetField outperforms Harris-3D and five learned 3D keypoint methods on objects and on real indoor scenes. On unseen rooms, it improves localization success by 7.4 points over Harris-3D, the strongest baseline. On objects, it also leads under a 2D detector not used in training. On sparse maps, it stays ahead of Harris-3D on both objects and real scenes.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把 3D 显著性定义为「图像可检测性」，即以 2D 兴趣点检测器在各可见视角下的响应聚合作为监督，训练一个以点云为输入的连续 3D 场 DetField，在定位基准上优于 Harris-3D 与五个学习式 3D 关键点方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「哪些视觉证据在多个视角下可被稳定检出」的连续空间场，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与 LOOK 决策提供一种与视角无关的可用性度量，但属 3D 定位场景，与多模态推理的联系有待核查。

title: Not Every Input Needs Everything: Unifying Expert Gating, Model Cascades, and Agent Orchestration
summary: Executing monolithic neural weights, frontier foundation models, or entire multi-agent workflows uniformly on every input incurs substantial computational, latency, and monetary overhead. Conditional computation mitigates this cost by deciding dynamically which internal experts, model endpoints, or specialized agents to invoke per request. Yet token-level gating in sparse neural architectures, query-level model cascades, and task-level multi-agent coordination have largely progressed in disconnected research silos, obscuring recurring system failures and transferable fixes. In this systematic review, we synthesize 2,289 studies published between 2017 and September 2026 (selected from 13,884 unique records) across 20 methodological families under a unified two-step inspect-then-allocate framework. Discrete hard selection accounts for 70%, 83%, and 91% of token-, query-, and task-scale literature respectively, and computational overhead appears as a top operational bottleneck across every layer. Engineering safeguards remain sharply asymmetric: intra-layer gating prioritizes load balancing while rarely incorporating uncertainty estimation, whereas model selection and agent orchestration rely on confidence thresholds and budget rules while confronting miscalibration and cascading errors. At the same time, publication volume is accelerating fastest in agentic task delegation, where routing mechanisms are least often isolated experimentally and methodological bias risk is highest.

AI.brief_summary: 系统综述 2289 篇研究，用统一的「先检查再分配」框架整合 token 级稀疏门控、查询级模型级联与任务级多智能体编排，统计硬选择占比与计算开销瓶颈。
AI.relevance_reason: 其条件计算分配、置信阈值与预算规则的分类，可能为 LVR 的 THINK/LOOK/STOP 收益成本权衡、停止决策与计算开销核算提供问题框架，但材料不涉及视觉证据与 latent 状态，迁移线索可供核查。

title: Unstable Action Boundaries in Lethal Drone Agents
summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents raise safety risks that are not captured by text-only refusal behavior, especially when tools can trigger high-impact actions. This concern is salient in military settings, where autonomous weapons raise the possibility of delegating force decisions to software agents. In this work, we study whether a drone agent's action boundary is stable under changes to the target descriptor. We evaluate recent and popular LLMs in a simulated perception-action pipeline over real-world drone imagery, where models can localize requested targets and invoke a simulated lethal tool. We find two concerning failure modes. First, some LLM agents invoke the lethal tool for ordinary generic descriptors such as \emph{people}, requiring no jailbreak at all. Second, an agent that initially appears conservative under protected descriptors can become unsafe under a simple semantic target shift.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在基于真实无人机影像的模拟感知-动作流水线中评估多个 LLM 代理，考察目标描述符变化时是否会调用模拟致命工具，发现对「people」等泛化描述即可触发、且受保护描述下显得保守的代理在语义偏移后变得不安全。
AI.relevance_reason: 其固定图像、变动目标描述以探测行动边界稳定性的做法，可供核查 VLM 推理中视觉证据是否真正约束高风险动作决策，以及内部状态里任务必要视觉信息是否被使用，属间接启发线索。

title: MUSE: Multi-Task Uncertainty-Aware Self-Supervised Encoder for mmWave ISAC
summary: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) allows a wireless system to use the same waveform for communication and environment sensing. At mmWave frequency bands, ISAC enables diverse human sensing tasks, such as localization, gesture recognition, and pose estimation, with high precision. However, each task requires training a dedicated model, typically from scratch on a task-specific dataset, with no mechanism to flag unreliable predictions. This hurts the scalability, transferability, and reliability of mmWave ISAC models. In this work, we propose MUSE (Multi-task Uncertainty-aware Self-supervised Encoder), a unified framework for mmWave human sensing. MUSE leverages a self-supervised transformer model with per-dataset tokenization and is trained via masked autoencoding across five datasets. During fine-tuning, MUSE uses evidential classification heads that enable uncertainty quantification. MUSE replaces N separate encoders with a single shared transformer encoder, an N-times backbone parameter reduction, while achieving a 9.7 percentage points improvement in classification performance compared to the task-specific model, showing that learning jointly across tasks improves per-task generalization. Across four classification tasks, MUSE produces reliable uncertainty estimates that enable selective prediction, improving accuracy by abstaining on the least confident 20% of predictions. We further improve the reliability of the model's confidence estimates using temperature scaling and conformal prediction. Finally, MUSE's uncertainty signal remains reliable even under cross-user deployment, assigning higher uncertainty to wrong predictions than to correct ones 78% of the time, and recovering 9.2 percentage points of accuracy through selective prediction, with no additional retraining on the unseen user.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MUSE：用单一共享自监督 transformer 跨五个 mmWave 数据集做掩码自编码预训练，并以证据式分类头给出不确定性，支持选择性预测与温度缩放、conformal prediction 校准。

title: A Calibration-Referenced Protocol for Measuring Decision Stability under Reference Bank Compression
comment: 54 pages, including supplementary material (Tables S1-S11 and Figures S1-S4). Interval summaries and probe-sensitivity CSV files are included as ancillary material
summary: Reference banks used for industrial image inspection can be compressed to fit a deployment budget, but the resulting anomaly decisions depend on both the compressed scores and the operating threshold. We present a four-step protocol that compares compression methods at matched deployment sizes, establishes a reference distribution from 200 recalibrations, evaluates disagreement against two calibration benchmarks, and measures changes by distance from the full-bank threshold. With WideResNet-50, budget-matched product quantization (PQ) at the 10% budget has the lowest decision disagreement among five matched methods, including int8 scalar quantization, on VisA and MVTec AD at both operating levels. Int8 scalar quantization gives lower disagreement than PQ at the other four budgets. On MVTec AD at the lower operating level, PQ meets the calibration median in 34/39 cells and the upper quantile in 39/39 cells. Category-equally weighted image-level AUROC loss at this budget ranges from 0.0003 to 0.0037 across the evaluated configurations. On VisA at the 1% budget and a 1% operating level, disagreement reaches 28.12% (95% CI 23.25--33.58%) among near-threshold anomalies and 1.30% (0.79--2.14%) across the normal holdout. The 10% budget-matched PQ setting retains the lowest disagreement among four compared methods with ResNet-18, with clean reference banks, and when thresholds are estimated from normal-directory probes. The protocol connects deployment size to a calibration-referenced decision measure and identifies the evaluation populations most informative for inspection.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出四步评测协议，在相同部署预算下比较参考库压缩方法（如 PQ、int8 量化），用 200 次重校准建立参考分布，并测量阈值附近的决策不一致率，在 VisA、MVTec AD 上报告结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「压缩后决策稳定性」与「近阈值样本 vs 正常留出集」的分层评估思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中停止或判定决策在压缩内部状态与阈值漂移下的可靠性评价方式，但对象为工业异常检测，迁移性尚需判断。

title: SOC-Net: Second-Order-Cone-Constrained Neural Networks
summary: In many applications, neural networks must learn input-output maps that respect prior knowledge such as physical laws, safety requirements, and operating limits. These requirements constrain which outputs are admissible for a given input and often admit second-order cone (SOC) representations, including norm bounds and robust linear inequalities. Examples in control include friction cones, thrust bounds, and input-robust control barrier function (CBF) conditions. However, existing approaches to enforcing general input-dependent SOC constraints require a conic solver, an iterative scheme whose feasibility depends on convergence, or an interior feasible point for each input. We propose SOC-Net, a neural network architecture that enforces input-dependent SOC constraints by construction for every input, even outside the training distribution. SOC-Net projects an affine lifting of the backbone output onto the reachable slice of a fixed product of Lorentz cones and maps the correction back to the output space. For separable constraints, this projection splits into one projection per cone, and each is available in closed form or reduces to a single scalar equation, regardless of the cone dimension. We prove that SOC-Net retains the expressive power of the backbone network under regularity conditions and accommodates end-to-end training by standard backpropagation with an explicit Jacobian. Experiments on contact force allocation with friction constraints and 3-D obstacle avoidance with an input-robust CBF demonstrate that SOC-Net satisfies the constraints at every evaluated input, with lower evaluation latency than the tested solver-based and iterative baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SOC-Net：把骨干网络输出的仿射提升投影到固定 Lorentz 锥乘积的可达切片上，使输出对任意输入按构造满足二阶锥约束，并给出可分离情形的闭式或单标量方程求解与显式雅可比，用于摩擦锥力分配和基于 CBF 的避障。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按构造投影到可行集、无需迭代求解」的思路，可能为把 latent 推理状态约束到可容许区域（如几何或安全可行集）提供问题表述上的借鉴，但论文面向控制约束满足，与视觉推理的关联尚待核查。

title: An Image Detectability Field as a Viewpoint Utility for 2D-3D Localization in Sparse Maps
summary: In 2D-3D localization, a camera estimates its pose by matching an image to a 3D map. A camera held in a hand or mounted on a robot can often choose its viewpoint before it takes the image. In this work, we ask whether an image detectability field is a useful viewpoint utility when the planner reads only the geometry of the map. The field can be queried at any 3D point near a surface. From the local geometry around the point, it predicts how likely a 2D image detector is to fire at the projection of the point. We use the trained field as it is, without fine-tuning it for view selection. A fixed SuperPoint and EPnP-RANSAC localizer then estimates the pose from the chosen view. We answer in two settings, each with a test registered before the runs. On synthetic ShapeNet objects with sparse point maps, summing the field over the visible landmarks beats counting them by +2.0 points of localization success rate (object-clustered 95% interval [+0.7, +3.2]). It also beats summing Harris-3D ranks by +2.2 [+0.8, +3.5]. On real indoor scenes from SceneFun3D, our adaptation of the learned view scorer LWL falls below counting on the test rooms. We therefore add the field to a learned per-landmark planner. On the test rooms with sparse maps whose landmarks the field also selects, the planner with the field beats the same planner without it by +1.8 points. It beats the planner with Harris-3D or curvature in its place by +1.0 and +0.8 points. All three room-clustered intervals lie above zero. In both settings, the field helps in sparse maps and is on par with Harris-3D in dense maps.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究2D-3D定位中的「先选视点再拍摄」问题，提出图像可检测性场：仅由地图局部几何预测2D检测器在某个3D点投影处触发的概率，并将其作为视点效用，配合固定的SuperPoint与EPnP-RANSAC定位器，在合成ShapeNet与真实SceneFun3D稀疏地图上检验其相对计数、Harris-3D和学习式打分器的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 该场本质是「某个观测能提供多少可用视觉证据」的预测量，与LVR中LOOK决策、证据筛选和视觉信息价值评估有概念联系，可供核查其能否作为推理中选择观察位置或判断证据充分性的效用函数；但论文面向机器人定位，未涉及多模态推理状态。

title: Benefit of Structured Representations: When Equivariance Helps in Image Classification
summary: Equivariant neural networks promise improved representation learning through structural guarantees. However, mainstream vision encoders rarely incorporate equivariance for most geometric symmetries. Images are a particularly interesting modality with many such symmetries and extensive datasets from which to learn this structure. In this work, we investigate when vision encoders benefit from geometric inductive biases. We study the discrete rotation group of quarter-turns (C4) which acts losslessly without interpolation or boundary artifacts. Combined with image classification as a controlled invariant objective, this allows for a principled empirical investigation into the role of structural guarantees. We introduce ConvNeXt-C4 as a rotation equivariant ConvNeXt with dimension-equivalent yet orientation-structured representations. Training from scratch, our experiments show, that the C4 variant outperforms its base model across all tasks while operating with 6x fewer parameters and 1.6x fewer FLOPs. Its performance advantage increases log-linearly with decreasing training set size, with pre-training providing a similar improvement across both model variants. Analyzing the classifier head reveals that orientation information from the representations' structure is actively used, improving performance by 4.90% across all datasets. Our results highlight the sample-efficiency benefits of equivariance and the value of retained orientation information, motivating further investigation beyond image classification. Code is available at https://github.com/hlzl/equivariant-convnext.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 C4 四分之一旋转等变的 ConvNeXt-C4，在图像分类这一受控不变目标下比较其与基线，发现等变结构带来更小参数与计算量、随训练集缩小而增大的样本效率优势，并通过分类头分析表明表示中的朝向信息被实际使用。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接关联，但其「表示几何保留何种信息、以及下游是否真的用到该信息」的分析思路，可能为 latent 状态中视觉细节是否被利用这类问题提供刻画与核查线索。

title: Non-Linear Motion from Two Frames: Cubic Hermite Trajectories for Video Frame Interpolation
summary: Two-frame video frame interpolation commonly resamples endpoint optical flow by the query time, which selects a constant-velocity straight-line path even though the same endpoint displacement is compatible with many intermediate trajectories. We present HermiteVFI, which replaces independent query-time motion prediction with one explicit continuous trajectory per pixel. The measured endpoint displacement fixes the two trajectory positions, while two latent endpoint derivatives learned from the frame pair control the interior path. A cubic Hermite curve is the minimum-degree polynomial that can independently satisfy these two position and two derivative boundary quantities. Its residual form contains linear motion exactly, structurally preserves the measured displacement endpoints for any network output, and has coefficients that are predicted once per frame pair and evaluated in closed form at arbitrary t. We further show that one interior query time gives a rank-deficient constraint on the two free trajectory coefficients, whereas any two distinct interior times are full rank at the representation level, motivating multi-time supervision. Appearance-derived directional cues help infer the latent derivatives that endpoint displacement alone cannot identify. On X4K1000FPS, SNU-FILM, and Vimeo90K-Septuplet, the largest gains occur for difficult non-uniform motion and high interpolation ratios. The amortization applies to trajectory-coefficient prediction; downstream reversal, refinement, and synthesis remain query dependent.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 HermiteVFI，用每像素一条三次 Hermite 连续轨迹替代按查询时间重采样端点光流的做法：端点位移固定轨迹两端位置，由帧对学出的两个 latent 端点导数控制内部路径，系数每对帧预测一次并在任意 t 处闭式求值；并指出单个内部时刻对两个自由系数构成秩亏约束，两个不同内部时刻才满秩，据此引入多时刻监督，在 X4K1000FPS 等基准上对非均匀大幅运动和高插值倍率增益最大。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属视频插帧，但「一次性预测 latent 轨迹参数、在任意 t 闭式求值」与多时刻监督的秩分析，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的连续轨迹表示及「贡献分配—监督时刻设计」提供类比线索，可供核查。

title: HSTTA: Hierarchical Selective Test-Time Adaptation for Label-Free Cross-Subject EEG-to-Image Retrieval
summary: Cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval suffers from substantial performance degradation on new subjects due to subject shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) can mitigate this shift by adapting pretrained models with unlabeled target-subject EEG. However, most existing TTA methods struggle to match supervision granularity to each query's prediction confidence, leaving many queries without reliable pseudo-labels. To address this, we propose a novel framework named Hierarchical Selective Test-Time Adaptation (HSTTA). HSTTA builds a hierarchy over gallery image embeddings, uses hierarchical selective prediction to assign each EEG query a supervision granularity matching its current prediction confidence, and constructs adaptation objectives accordingly. We further propose Cross-Session Consistency Calibration (CSCC), an unsupervised method that calibrates the global confidence threshold to target a predefined accuracy level for hierarchical predictions. Moreover, we introduce Reciprocal Hierarchical Backoff (RHB), which moves queries lacking reverse-matching support to coarser nodes to mitigate error reinforcement. Experiments on two public benchmarks and ablation studies validate the effectiveness of HSTTA and its key components. On THINGS-EEG2, HSTTA outperforms the strongest EEG-specific TTA baseline by 17.9 (13.4) and 8.9 (3.7) percentage points in Top-1/Top-5 accuracy, respectively, under cosine (CSLS) ranking. Further analyses show that HSTTA yields more accurate pseudo-labels during adaptation, supporting more reliable model updates.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向跨被试 EEG-to-image 检索中的被试偏移问题，提出分层选择性测试时自适应框架：在图库图像嵌入上构建层级，按每个查询的预测置信度分配不同粒度的伪标签监督，并用跨会话一致性校准全局置信阈值、以互惠分层回退减少错误强化。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作与 LVR 主线距离较远，但其「按置信度选择监督/决策粒度并按目标精度校准阈值」的做法，可能为 latent 推理中基于置信度的证据细化与停止决策提供概念参考，具体可迁移性仍需核查。

title: Cell-Type-Specific Expression Is Hard to Predict from Bulk, but It Is Still Useful
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Drug Discovery (AI4DD). 5 pages main text, 28 pages total
summary: Single-cell-informed deconvolution provides cell-type-resolved features for clinical bulk RNA cohorts. Most existing methods predict the proportions $π_k$ of the $K$ constituent cell types (CTs). Fewer predict cell-type-specific expression (CTSE) $μ_{kg}$ of gene $g$ in CT $k$, which can capture cell states that proportions miss, but recent benchmarks find it much harder. We explain this gap with closed-form accuracy bounds. For CTSE, we derive an $R^2$ ceiling for per-gene linear estimators. For proportions, the best linear estimator, which pools evidence across genes, has a closed-form $R^2$, and a computable lower bound on it predicts which CTs are learnable. We study targeted deconvolution of 106 biologically curated (CT, gene) pairs, found post hoc to have higher learnability scores. On overall survival in non-small cell lung cancer, estimation difficulty does not predict prognostic value across these targets. Yet a sparse survival model on deconvolved features, mostly CTSE, predicts survival as well as a sparse model on the bulk genes themselves, while attributing its signal to specific cell types. Some deconvolved CTSE features reveal prognostic signal not seen in the corresponding bulk gene.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究从 bulk RNA 数据预测细胞类型特异表达（CTSE）为何远难于预测细胞比例，给出逐基因线性估计器的 R² 上界与比例估计的可计算下界，并在非小细胞肺癌生存预测中检验去卷积特征的价值。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 VLM 推理无直接关系，但其「从聚合观测中以闭式上界刻画线性估计可恢复多少成分信号」的分析思路，可能为 latent 视觉状态中信息坍缩与可解码细节的定量界限提供类比与核查线索。

title: Compute-Aware Submodular Online Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
summary: This paper studies policy learning for cooperative task allocation in open multi-agent systems, where submodular utilities model diminishing marginal returns due to overlapping agent contributions. While standard methods evaluate every candidate action to update the policy, this may incur an excessive computational cost online. Hence, we impose a budget on these evaluations and analytically study the effect of query budget on online learning. Our algorithm samples a prescribed number of agent-action pairs and applies inverse-probability weighting to their marginal gains, yielding an unbiased gradient estimate of the expected stage utility for a Kullback-Leibler (KL) mirror-ascent update. We derive a $1/2$-approximate regret bound that elegantly splits into a tracking error between optimal and learned policies, quantified by their KL divergence, and a query-dependent feedback term. Experiments on cooperative information coverage show that our approach retains high performance with significantly less computation online.

AI.brief_summary: 研究开放多智能体系统中合作任务分配的在线策略学习：在 submodular 效用下，对候选动作评估施加查询预算，用采样与逆概率加权得到无偏梯度，并给出随预算变化的 regret 界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「重叠贡献导致边际收益递减」与「有限查询下的计算—收益分解」可能启发 LVR 中视觉证据子集筛选与 THINK/LOOK 计算预算的取舍，但属于远领域线索，需核查可迁移性。

title: EgoMyo: Physical Hand State Estimation from Egocentric Video and Wrist Electromyography
summary: Physical hand interaction depends on configuration, contact, and force, yet nearly identical appearances can conceal different contact states and exerted forces. We therefore formulate physical hand state estimation from egocentric video and wrist surface electromyography (sEMG), combining visual geometry with neuromuscular evidence to jointly recover these coupled components. To support this task, we introduce EgoMyo, a benchmark spanning 5.75M video frames, 50 participants, 34 contact configurations, and repeated donnings, synchronizing these inputs with 3D hand pose and with contact and normal force registered onto the hand surface from bare-hand pressure. Controlled analysis reveals that vision resolves spatial structure while sEMG better estimates force magnitude, that sEMG's gains concentrate in regions where vision is least reliable, and that contact localization limits force accuracy. Guided by these findings, we propose MyoBridge, which makes the hand region the unit of vision-sEMG fusion, lets each region gate its own share of sEMG, and distributes regional force magnitudes only over predicted contact vertices at inference. On held-out trials, MyoBridge reduces pose and force error by 39.8% and 18.5% over the strongest baseline and achieves the lowest pose error on unseen sessions and subjects.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EgoMyo 基准（575 万帧、50 名被试的自我中心视频与腕部 sEMG，配 3D 手部姿态及接触、法向力标注）与 MyoBridge，以手部区域为单位门控 sEMG 贡献，并将区域力大小分配到推断出的接触点。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「视觉负责空间结构、sEMG 在视觉最不可靠处收益最大」的受控发现与区域级可靠性门控融合，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、辅助信号路由与模态贡献评价提供线索；但任务本身是生理信号的手部状态估计，并非 VLM 推理。

title: Change Point Detection with Generative Models
summary: Change point detection (CPD) methods aim to identify abrupt changes in the properties of time series, which is a key problem in numerous fields. A major class of CPD approaches relies on computing a CPD score, which is either a discrepancy or divergence between two subsequent samples, called windows. A fundamental limitation of window-based CPD is the 'sample size bottleneck.' To ensure temporal precision, windows must be small; however, small samples provide insufficient statistical evidence for the classifiers and deep-learning models currently used to compute CPD scores. This leads to high variance in the scores and frequent mispredictions. Our study tackles this issue by exploring generative models for window augmentation, effectively expanding available data to improve CPD quality. Experiments on synthetic and real data demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly enhances CPD. Specifically, we show that this approach allows simple classifiers to outperform complex deep-learning baselines by stabilizing the CPD score distribution.

AI.brief_summary: 针对基于窗口的变点检测中「样本量瓶颈」——窗口需小以保证时间精度、但小样本使 CPD 分数方差大、误判多——该文用生成模型对窗口做增广以扩充数据，并在合成与真实数据上显示简单分类器可借分数分布稳定而优于复杂深度学习基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 变点检测与 LVR 中的停止决策、置信度/分数序列的突变监测可能有概念关联，其「小窗口导致分数方差大」的观察可供核查 latent 推理轨迹的稳定性与生成式增广监督；但属远领域，与视觉推理尚无直接证据。

title: OS-Omni: Benchmarking Generalist Computer-Using Agents on Long-Horizon Workflows Across Platforms
summary: Computer-using agents are increasingly expected to complete realistic user goals rather than isolated GUI actions. However, existing benchmarks typically isolate web, mobile, or desktop environments, leaving it unclear whether a single generalist agent can execute long-horizon workflows that span multiple operating systems and persistent application states. We introduce OS-Omni, a live cross-platform benchmark and execution environment for evaluating computer-using agents across Windows, Ubuntu, macOS, iOS, Android, and Web environments. OS-Omni is released in versioned waves of 300 tasks each; this paper focuses on the first release, v1, which contains 48 tasks per platform and 12 cross-platform workflows that pair a desktop with an Android phone. OS-Omni provides reproducible initialization, platform-specific adapters, trajectory logging, and executable final-state evaluators, and includes controlled service-backed applications for workflows involving account, cart, budget, calendar, message, and other persistent state. Human studies show that OS-Omni tasks require 67.54 interaction steps, substantially exceeding OSWorld references of 15.0 steps. On v1, the strongest evaluated agent, Claude Opus 5.5, reaches 68.5% average success, trailing the 77.3% human reference by 8.8 points; the gap is uneven across platforms, with frontier models exceeding humans on Linux but trailing them by more than 25 points on iOS and macOS. These results indicate that current agents remain far from platform-robust, long-horizon computer use, especially when success requires sustained state tracking and durable final-state changes.

AI.brief_summary: OS-Omni 构建跨 Windows、Ubuntu、macOS、iOS、Android 与 Web 的实时基准与执行环境，首版每平台 48 个任务并含 12 个桌面—手机协同工作流，提供可复现初始化、轨迹日志与可执行终态评估器，并比较多个智能体与人类的表现差距。
AI.relevance_reason: 该基准突出长程交互中的持续状态跟踪与终态改变，其轨迹日志和终态评估或可作为检验视觉证据保留与停止决策的外部测试床，可供核查；但并未涉及内部 latent 表示，联系需进一步确认。

title: VibeVideoAgent: Closing the Perceptual Loop for Code-Driven Video Generation
summary: Code-driven video generation asks a coding agent to write and run rendering programs. This gives exact control over typography, data visualizations, synchronized audio, and multi-shot scenes, and it leaves an editable project behind. A program that exits cleanly can still render overlapping labels, a camera aimed away from its subject, broken object interactions, or narration that drifts out of sync, and none of these raise a runtime error. Feeding rendered frames and audio back into the coding session bloats its long-horizon context, while critiquing only the finished full-resolution render turns early design mistakes into costly rewrites. We introduce VibeVideoAgent, a training-free framework that lets coding agents inspect their drafts throughout production. Multimodal perception runs in short-lived contexts kept apart from the coder and returns compact, grounded Findings. Seven primitives operate on a unified multi-clock representation of assets and drafts: they explore media from coarse to fine, verify quoted requirements with evidence from every required modality, compare a draft with a reference or an earlier revision on separate clocks, and measure stream signals locally. A lightweight staged protocol has the agent test its riskiest decision on a minimal preview first. On all 239 VibeVideoBench tasks, with matched agent runtimes and a fixed perception model, VibeVideoAgent improves holistic audiovisual quality (L3) for Claude Opus 5.5 (4.03 -> 4.43, while L2 rubric compliance rises from 98.87% to 99.35%), GPT-6 Astra (4.03 -> 4.27), and Claude Sonnet 5.5 (3.97 -> 4.10), with the largest gains in audio-visual synchronization (up to +0.56). Controlled ablations show that each component contributes, and trajectory audits show that the granularity of code edits governs the trade-off between rubric adherence and perceptual quality.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 VibeVideoAgent，让代码驱动的视频生成智能体在生产过程中反复检视草稿：感知在独立短上下文中运行并返回紧凑的 grounded Findings，配合从粗到细探索、带证据的需求核查、分时钟对比与流信号局部测量等七种原语，并先用最小预览检验风险最高的决策。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把感知与推理上下文分离、只回传紧凑证据」以及「先低成本预览验证高风险假设」的做法，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与何时继续 LOOK 的停止决策提供概念参照，但领域为视频生成，需核查可迁移性。

title: EXPOSURE: Explaining Sources of Uncertainty in Reinforcement Learning
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ESANN 2027. Code: https://github.com/kianaf/exposure-rl
summary: Shapley values in reinforcement learning are used to explain which observation features drive an agent's behavior and expected return, but not its certainty. Explaining certainty requires understanding how observation features influence different sources of return uncertainty, and Shapley values need the agent's prediction for every subset of visible features. We propose EXPOSURE, which uses one mask-aware belief network for both action selection and Shapley explanations. It explains the variance of the return, split into an observational part due to missing features and an inherent part due to the environment's own randomness, and the entropy of its belief over the masked features. In tic-tac-toe and Minesweeper, where exact Shapley values are computable, EXPOSURE gives more accurate explanations of expected return and its uncertainty, while uniquely explaining belief uncertainty.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EXPOSURE，用单一的 mask-aware belief network 同时执行动作选择与 Shapley 解释，将回报方差分解为缺失特征导致的可观测部分和环境固有部分，并解释模型对遮挡特征的信念熵；在井字棋和扫雷中与精确 Shapley 值对照验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对缺失特征、信念熵与不确定性来源的分解，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、继续 LOOK 的决策及 latent 状态不确定性归因提供概念线索；但研究限于小型 RL 任务，与 VLM 推理的距离需进一步核查。

title: MedSkill-E$^{2}$: Evaluating and Evolving Skills for Medical Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills to access domain knowledge and complete real-world tasks. We observe that even when a skill specifies the rules and procedures needed for a task, agents may fail to apply them effectively during autonomous execution, a phenomenon we call skill Enable But Underuse (EBU). This issue is particularly consequential in medical tasks, where overlooking a single critical constraint can yield a plausible but incorrect result. To evaluate and address EBU, we introduce MedSkill-E$^{2}$, a framework for evaluating and evolving skills for medical agents. We construct EBU-Bench, a challenging benchmark covering 12 medically relevant task groups and associated skills, to evaluate agents' ability to use available skills autonomously. We quantify the EBU gap as the difference in skill-use accuracy between autonomous use and explicitly guided reading and application of the same skill. On EBU-Bench, all evaluated model-harness combinations exhibit EBU, with a mean gap of 43.94 percentage points (pp). For the same model, skill-use accuracy under autonomous use differs by up to 38.96 pp across harnesses. Motivated by these observations, we propose EBU-Evolve, which uses execution feedback from autonomous and explicitly guided skill use to distill effective guidance into reusable skill instructions. Relative to their pre-evolution versions, the revised skills improve skill-use accuracy during autonomous execution by 33.33 to 55.17 pp and continue to yield improvements when transferred across multiple models and harnesses. Our results show that autonomous skill-use accuracy varies across harnesses with the model and skill held fixed, and model rankings can change. EBU can persist even after a skill is opened. EBU-Evolve improves autonomous skill-use accuracy on unseen tasks within the same skill, with gains transferring across models and harnesses.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MedSkill-E² 框架与 EBU-Bench，量化医疗 agent「技能已获得却未有效使用」的现象，并用自主执行与显式引导的执行反馈来演化技能指令。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心区分「信息可用但未被利用」，并以自主使用与显式引导的准确率差作为度量，可能与 LVR 中判断 latent 视觉证据是否真正参与答案生成的诊断思路相通，可供核查。

title: Crucible: Evaluating LLM Agents in Executable Chemistry Research Environments
summary: Large language models (LLMs) perform well on chemistry knowledge benchmarks, which mainly assess question answering and isolated tasks. Chemical research, however, requires using specialized tools and interpreting their outputs to obtain chemically valid results. To address this gap, we introduce Crucible Bench to evaluate this ability across all four stages of the design-make-test-analyze (DMTA) cycle. The benchmark contains 1,078 tasks in 12 task families curated from 18 published datasets, covering molecular design, synthesis planning, experimental execution, closed-loop optimization, simulation, and analytical characterization. Agents access 75 domain-specific tools through the Model Context Protocol in seven isolated environments. Sandboxed graders verify the resulting synthesis routes, experimental protocols, and other outputs. Laboratory tasks use robotic simulators or previously measured experimental data. We evaluate 14 LLMs as agents and find that the best achieves an overall score of 0.545, with synthesis planning and closed-loop optimization emerging as the hardest domains. Overall performance does not predict optimization performance well: the model ranked twelfth overall achieves the highest score in closed-loop optimization. Error analysis also shows that agents often submit chemically invalid results despite running their tools successfully. Stronger models benefit more from tool access, but reliable use of chemical software remains a challenge that Crucible Bench can track as models improve.

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建 Crucible Bench，在化学 DMTA 全流程的七个隔离环境中，让 LLM agent 通过 MCP 调用 75 个专业工具，并用沙盒评分器核验合成路线与实验方案等输出。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「工具调用成功但化学结果无效」的错误分析与闭环优化设定，可能为 LVR 中证据获取、答案是否真正使用证据及停止决策的评价设计提供参照，但与视觉 latent 推理无直接关系，需核查其评分与错误分类是否可迁移。

title: ReMeDi: Single-Image PBR Material Estimation via Reparameterization between Metal and Dielectric Hypotheses
summary: Physically based rendering (PBR) material estimation facilitates relighting, material editing, and 3D content creation. As the reflectance of a surface heavily depends on whether it is a metal or a dielectric, producing any map that determines albedo involves a decision on metalness, which we call the "intended metalness" of the map. Rendering maps with mismatched intended metalness yields physically implausible or misinterpreted materials. The metallic--roughness workflow makes metalness explicit and thus encourages base color to match it, but does not enforce this match, especially for automated methods directly predicting each map. Therefore, we propose ReMeDi, which enforces the match through two components. First, we reparameterize base color as a metalness-weighted blend of its two variants, estimated under the all-metal and all-dielectric hypothesis, respectively. Second, as available supervision cannot teach a single network both hypotheses at every pixel, we restrict each of two separate networks to one hypothesis, so that each variant is ensured to follow its hypothesis. Besides enforcing the match, this also improves each estimated material map. Experiments show that ReMeDi outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both material accuracy and relighting fidelity.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ReMeDi 做单图 PBR 材质估计：分别在「全金属」与「全介质」假设下用两个受限子网络估计 base color 变体，再以 metalness 加权混合进行重参数化，使材质图与其「意图金属度」保持一致，从而提升材质精度与重光照保真度。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 主线距离较远，但其「多个假设各自被约束、再由一个显式权重混合并强制与输出一致」的重参数化，可能为 latent 多假设表示与一致性门控提供类比线索，值得核查。

title: StateWeaver: Multi-Agent Coordination of Story-State Transitions for Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Modern video foundation models generate high-quality short clips, but preserving long-video consistency and correctly depicting event-driven state changes remain challenging. Existing agentic workflows face these challenges because continual planning and repair accumulate context, while reference updates remain limited. We introduce StateWeaver, which combines Active States and Hierarchical Collaboration to connect review-driven visual reference updates with cross-shot state inheritance. Active States translate state discrepancies identified during review into concrete visual asset requirements that guide reference construction, validation, and regeneration, preserving identity and already-correct content while repairing target attributes. Confirmed generation results are linked to the corresponding asset states, story time, and reference versions for verification and reuse by subsequent shots. Hierarchical Collaboration isolates execution contexts by task, clip, and repair round, and uses hierarchical memory to organize this process across multiple sets. Across multiple benchmarks, StateWeaver outperforms existing methods and produces long videos with sustained cross-shot consistency under predefined and autonomously planned storyboards.

AI.brief_summary: 该文面向长时程视频生成的一致性难题，提出 StateWeaver：用「Active States」把审查阶段发现的状态偏差转成具体视觉资产需求以指导参考图构建与重生成，并以分层协作和分层记忆隔离任务、片段与修复轮次的执行上下文。
AI.relevance_reason: 其显式状态记录（资产状态、故事时间、参考版本）与「审查—定位偏差—定向修复」的循环，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新、证据筛选与是否继续修复的停止决策提供概念参照，但领域为视频生成，具体可迁移性需核查。

title: EvoLink-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Interdependent Task Streams
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from passive chatbots into autonomous systems that operate continuously in dynamic environments. Such agents need not only solve current tasks but also learn from past interactions to improve future performance. However, existing streaming benchmarks often rely on short task sequences or largely independent tasks, providing limited evidence of whether agents can effectively reuse experience when later tasks depend on earlier outcomes. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{EvoLink-Bench}, a benchmark for evaluating self-evolving agents in long-horizon, interdependent task streams. It covers daily office work, multi-turn dialogue, and AutoResearch-style workflows, with persistent workspaces and dependencies across tasks. The benchmark includes two complementary levels: \textbf{L1}, which evaluates the acquisition and revision of language-expressible knowledge, and \textbf{L2}, which assesses the development of task-level capabilities through execution and feedback. Its evaluation further distinguishes within-task recovery, persistent-state updates, and experience reuse in later tasks. We evaluate five agent frameworks across three backbone configurations under three persistence conditions, covering 19,635 scored task slots from selected evaluation cohorts. Results show that no framework consistently performs best across both levels, retries recover only a limited proportion of failed tasks, and persistent-state updates do not necessarily improve subsequent performance. Furthermore, the effects of evolution differ between knowledge- and capability-level tasks, suggesting that these two forms of evolution require different learning mechanisms. Performance gains also vary across domains and task streams, with improvements on some tasks not necessarily extending to others.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 EvoLink-Bench，用于评测长时程、任务间相互依赖的任务流中自演化 agent：覆盖日常办公、多轮对话与 AutoResearch 工作流，设 L1（可语言表达知识的获取与修订）和 L2（凭执行与反馈发展任务能力）两个层次，并将评测拆分为任务内恢复、持久状态更新与后续任务的经验复用，在五种 agent 框架、三种骨干与三种持久化条件下发现无框架全面占优，持久状态更新也不必然带来后续提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把「状态持久更新」与「后续复用收益」分开度量、并报告状态更新未必有益的协议，可能为 LVR 中跨步 latent 状态是否真被使用及贡献分配提供可核查的评测参照；但材料中任务均为文本工作流、无视觉表示，与视觉推理主线的距离较远。

title: Agentic Waterfall: An Intent-Driven Information Discovery Framework for Reclaiming User Control in the Attention Economy
summary: We formalize Agentic Waterfall Feed, a new problem of personalized information discovery in which users actively direct recommendations and the system adapts to evolving needs inferred from both explicit requests and browsing behavior. We address this problem with the Agentic Waterfall framework, whose language-model controller maintains persistent user state and coordinates content retrieval, ranking, and state updates. To evaluate systems on this task, we contribute the Agentic Waterfall Dataset and a replay-based evaluation protocol. The dataset combines real content metadata with simulated interaction histories. The protocol compares systems under shared histories using relevance scores and blind judgments of how well recommendations satisfy current user goals and constraints. Agentic Waterfall remains competitive with strong baselines on conventional recommendation tasks across five public benchmarks. On the Agentic Waterfall Dataset, it outperforms the strongest baseline in both evaluations, with relative improvements of up to 16.1%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「Agentic Waterfall Feed」这一由用户主动引导的个性化信息发现问题，用 LLM 控制器维护持久用户状态并协调内容检索、排序与状态更新，同时构建数据集与基于重放的评测协议。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「持久状态 + 按需检索 + 状态更新」的控制器循环，可能与 LVR 中潜在推理状态的维护、证据获取与停止决策（LOOK/STOP）有概念对应，可供核查其状态表示与评测设计是否可迁移。

title: One Representation to Rule Them All -- Open-Vocabulary Change Detection from Text or Visual Examples
summary: Open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) aims to localise user-specified changes without retraining for predefined categories. Existing approaches typically rely on textual descriptions and combine separate models for region proposal, semantic recognition, and temporal comparison. This limits how target concepts can be expressed and makes detection dependent on several intermediate predictions. We introduce OVTSID3, a training-free framework that unifies region grouping, concept identification, and temporal comparison in the representation space of DINOv3. OVTSID3 supports two complementary modes of concept specification: zero-shot textual queries or one-shot visual prompting through a masked reference pair. OVTSID3 outperforms all prior training-free OVCD methods on two building and two natural-disaster benchmarks, raising the average F1 by 8.9 points. OVTSID3 also supports semantic change detection and achieves state-of-the-art on SECOND. These results demonstrate the flexibility of a unified representation for text- or example-guided change detection without task-specific model training.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 OVTSID3 框架，在 DINOv3 表示空间中统一完成区域分组、概念识别与时相比较，支持零样本文本查询和基于掩码参考对的一次性视觉提示，用于开放词汇变化检测。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作在冻结视觉表示中直接做概念指定与跨时相比对、绕开独立中间预测，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选及「文本 vs 视觉示例」指定方式提供参照，但任务属遥感变化检测，需核查其相似度比较机制可否迁移。

title: Evaluating Aviation Safety Knowledge Extraction with SmolLM2: From Zero-Shot to Retrieval-Grounded Prompting
summary: Aviation accident narratives contain safety knowledge that is difficult to capture using structured occurrence fields alone. This study evaluates prompting-based knowledge extraction across four dimensions: concept accuracy, verbatim evidence grounding, structural compliance, and directed relation extraction. SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct was evaluated under zero-shot, one-shot, fixed few-shot, and retrieval-grounded prompting using 300 National Transportation Safety Board narratives from 2000-2020, containing 3,763 reference concepts and 467 directed relations. Evaluation combined structural checks, verbatim evidence matching, expert-reviewed semantic matching, and paired bootstrap confidence intervals. No prompting strategy performed best across all dimensions. Retrieval-grounded prompting achieved the highest concept micro-F1 of 32.27%, although its advantage over fixed few-shot prompting was uncertain (95% CI: -0.92 to 2.40 percentage points). One-shot prompting achieved the highest relation F1 of 6.95%, identifying directed relation extraction as the principal SmolLM2 bottleneck. Compared with fixed few-shot prompting, retrieval improved verbatim grounding (59.45% vs. 54.02%) but reduced complete structural compliance (33.3% vs. 42.7%). Verbatim matching establishes source presence rather than evidential relevance. An exploratory comparison using 35 benchmark narratives showed that Qwen3-8B achieved higher concept micro-F1 across all prompting conditions and higher relation F1 under demonstration-based prompting, reaching 51.37% and 34.62%, respectively, under one-shot prompting. The small subset limits generalization. These findings support evaluating semantic correctness, source traceability, structural reliability, and directed relation accuracy separately.

AI.brief_summary: 该文用 SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct 在 300 篇 NTSB 航空事故叙述上比较 zero-shot、one-shot、固定 few-shot 与 retrieval-grounded prompting，从概念准确率、逐字证据支撑、结构合规和有序关系抽取四个维度评估知识抽取，发现无策略全面占优，有序关系抽取是主要瓶颈。
AI.relevance_reason: 属纯文本抽取任务，但其把语义正确性、来源可追溯性、结构可靠性与关系准确率分开评估的做法，可供核查 LVR 中「视觉证据是否被真正使用」的度量设计；文中「逐字匹配只证明来源存在、不证明证据相关」的观察，可能与 latent 推理的证据筛选与贡献分配评价相通。

title: Most of the Way There: Turning a Strong Video Prior into an Action-Conditioned World Model
summary: Modern video generators excel at producing visually plausible futures guided by text and image prompts. Yet their emphasis on semantic plausibility does not guarantee fidelity to the physical consequences of specific actions. Action-conditioned world models (ACWMs), in contrast, aim to simulate how the world responds to robot actions, enabling scalable policy evaluation and improvement without costly real-world rollouts. The challenge is not merely to generate a plausible future, but to predict what follows from a specific physical action. As video priors grow stronger, we ask how little adaptation is truly needed to bridge this gap. We introduce Dianjing, a minimal recipe that preserves and unlocks the capabilities of strong video priors through unified physical action conditioning, training concentrated at the high noise levels where motion and layout, and thus the consequences of actions, are decided, and native history conditioning. Built upon MiniMax H3, a 33B video foundation model, Dianjing freezes the pretrained backbone and trains only 0.34% of its parameters using approximately 65 hours of robot video across two embodiments, without additional robot-specific pretraining or camera calibration. Controlled ablations show that where training is allocated across noise levels matters more than how actions enter the network. On WorldOracle, which evaluates predictions against paired real-world executions, Dianjing achieves the best scores on four of the five evaluation tracks and ranks second on AgiBot-Long. Our findings suggest that strong video priors already bring us most of the way to world modeling; lightweight physical action grounding can unlock their potential for real-world prediction.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Dianjing，在 33B 视频基础模型上冻结主干、仅训练约 0.34% 参数，用统一动作条件与原生历史条件，将约 65 小时双本体机器人视频适配为动作条件世界模型，并在 WorldOracle 上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「训练集中在高噪声层级」的结论可能与 diffusion 式 latent 推理状态生成中的监督投入与贡献分配问题相关，动作条件未来预测也可类比动作—证据—后果的建模，但跨域可迁移性需核查。

title: ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
summary: Recent video generators produce realistic videos, yet controlling how scenes unfold remains challenging. Structural proxies, such as animated 3D blockouts, guide generation by specifying scene layout, motion, camera behavior, and event order. However, these coarse inputs leave details unspecified and may contain artifacts that should not be reproduced. Successful proxy-guided generation must therefore Preserve intended structure, Complete missing content and correct proxy artifacts, and Bind text, image, and audio conditions to the right entities and events. We introduce ProxyGenBench to study these interacting requirements, with 312 evaluation cases from 60 scenes across three scene tasks and controlled variations in proxy fidelity, text detail, and multimodal inputs. We evaluate five video generators using verified, case-specific checklists. Experiments show that proxies improve spatiotemporal control, but greater proxy detail can coincide with poorer completion, while strong structural adherence does not ensure correct binding.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ProxyGenBench，用 3D blockout 等结构化代理引导视频生成，构建 312 个案例并在代理保真度、文本细节与多模态输入变化下考察「保留结构、补全缺失、绑定条件」三项要求。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「代理越细→补全可能变差」及「结构遵循≠条件与实体正确绑定」的分解，可能为 latent 状态中结构抽象与视觉细节保留、证据与实体绑定的评价设计提供参照，但属视频生成，与 VLM 推理状态的联系仍需核查。

title: DiversePlace: Diversity-Seeking Curriculum Reinforcement Learning for Macro Placement
summary: Macro placement is a critical early-stage decision in physical design because macro locations strongly constrain subsequent implementation stages. The task is difficult because these high-impact discrete decisions must be made before downstream quality can be measured accurately, forcing training to rely on fast but imperfect training-time oracles such as half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL). Existing RL-based placers therefore mostly optimize single HPWL-driven solutions, and their long sequential horizons often require heavy search assistance or offline expert data while leaving little room to preserve multiple competitive layouts. We address this gap by making quality-controlled diversity an explicit objective for macro placement. Instead of relying on a single proxy-optimal solution, we maintain a compact archive of HPWL-competitive yet meaningfully different placements for downstream selection. We realize this idea in DiversePlace, a curriculum proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework that combines a quality-gated diversity reward with an expanding placement horizon, enabling from-scratch RL optimization while keeping exploration inside competitive HPWL regions. On the ISPD2005 benchmarks, DiversePlace consistently improves top-5, top-10, and top-20 archive diversity and achieves lower or virtually identical HPWL on all eight designs with better efficiency. Code: https://github.com/William030422/NIPS2026-DiversePlace.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把质量可控的多样性设为宏单元布局的显式目标，用质量门控的多样性奖励配合逐步扩展布局视野的 curriculum PPO，从零训练并维护一组 HPWL 有竞争力但彼此不同的布局存档供下游选择。
AI.relevance_reason: 「多样而同等可用」的解存档与质量门控探索，可能为 LVR 中并行维护多个 latent 推理假设、按质量筛选候选状态与后续选择提供问题表述上的参考。

title: TACC: Target-Aware Carrier Compression for Dense-Context Novel View Synthesis
summary: Recent feed-forward approaches mark a paradigm shift in novel view synthesis by eliminating the reliance on per-scene optimization, directly inferring 3D representations from input views. However, their reliance on global scene-token context incurs substantial memory and latency overhead, constraining their ability to handle increasingly dense source-view contexts. Compressing source representations offers an intuitive way to limit this token budget. Prior general-purpose compression methods are not tailored for novel view synthesis, as their fixed, target-agnostic nature fails to adapt evidence allocation to individual target views. To overcome this, we introduce TACC, a target-aware compression module tailored for feed-forward latent NVS. Specifically, TACC organizes each source view into a progressive carrier hierarchy. Driven by source-target geometric relevance, it adaptively retrieves tokens to dynamically allocate exact computational quotas. This selective retrieval directly yields a compact, target-conditioned representation. Extensive experiments on the RE10K demonstrate that under dense input settings, TACC achieves $9.23\times$ and $64\times$ higher Effective FPS than Full Context on LagerNVS and LVSM, respectively. Effective FPS excludes one-time source encoding and Carrier construction.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TACC，一个面向前馈 latent 新视角合成（NVS）的目标感知压缩模块：把每个源视图组织为渐进载体层级，并按源-目标几何相关性自适应检索 token、动态分配计算配额，以压缩稠密输入下的上下文开销。
AI.relevance_reason: 「依目标相关性筛选源侧视觉 token 并动态分配计算配额」的思路，可能与 LVR 中按问题或目标筛选视觉证据、动态分配计算的问题表述相通，但原文场景是 NVS 渲染效率而非推理，能否迁移到视觉旁路筛选可供核查。

title: ProManO: Beyond Sim(3) for Metric Upgrade of Feed-Forward Geometry with Visual-Inertial Anchors
summary: Upgrading feed-forward geometry to metric scale with visual-inertial odometry (VIO) raises the question of which correction should align dense feed-forward prediction with sparse metric VIO anchors. Existing methods use either a similarity transformation, which cannot represent depth-dependent distortion, or a projective transformation, which alters pre-calibrated intrinsics. We prove that the transformations compatible with pre-calibrated intrinsics form a ten-dimensional manifold. Beyond Sim(3), this manifold contains three degrees of freedom (DoF) that locate the plane at infinity and leave residuals growing quadratically with depth range after any similarity alignment. These DoF are invisible in the image and can be resolved only by metric depth along viewing rays or by multi-view constraints. To estimate them, we propose ProManO, a probabilistic manifold optimization framework in which every anchor is weighted by its along-ray uncertainty and inlier probability within a single expectation-maximization (EM) procedure. ProManO certifies the similarity synchronization and refines the plane at infinity only where it is observable, which guarantees an objective value no worse than that of the optimal similarity alignment. Experiments on EuRoC, CID-SIMS, Oxford Spires, and KITTI-360 demonstrate that ProManO achieves the highest mean F1 and outperforms Sim(3) alignment on all four datasets. The project page is available at https://h0xg.github.io/ProManO/.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究如何用稀疏 VIO 锚点把前馈几何预测升级到 metric scale：证明与预标定内参兼容的变换构成十维流形，指出 Sim(3) 之外的三个自由度决定无穷远平面位置，并提出按沿视线不确定性与内点概率加权的概率流形优化（EM）来估计这些自由度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「部分自由度在图像中不可观测、只能借助沿视线深度或多视角约束确定」的论述，可能与 LVR 中 latent 表示的可辨识性、以及判定需要何种视觉证据的思路形成类比，可供核查；但研究对象是 3D 几何尺度对齐而非推理状态，联系较远。

title: Auditing Identity and Timing Signals in Operational Logs
comment: 28 pages. Supplementary code and results included. WhoWhen library: https://github.com/mojolearn/whowhen
summary: Models that predict events from operational logs, such as sepsis in ICU records or failures in hard drives, can score well by recognizing which patient or drive a record came from, or when it was recorded, instead of predicting the event. I introduce two simple audits that measure how much of this information a dataset carries before any event-prediction model is trained, and apply them to seven public datasets in six domains. One asks whether a classifier can tell that two records came from the same unit; the other asks which of two records from the same unit came later. Under the stated nulls, both have expected AUC 0.5. In ICU data, the identity audit flags a common preprocessing step: carrying the last measurement forward raises identity AUC from 0.916 to 0.993. On a 12-hour sepsis forecasting task, carrying forward makes a model look 0.163 AUC better than raw values when a patient's hours are split between training and test, but only 0.046 better when patients are held out. The exaggeration under patient overlap also appears in a second ICU dataset with mortality as the outcome. On the sepsis task, a chronological control with complete follow-up, in which training sees only a patient's earlier, resolved hours, shows no positive mean overlap gap. Timing is a strong predictor: with complete follow-up, hour of stay and measurement counts alone, with no clinical value, score 0.761 on held-out patients, and adding the raw clinical values changes that by +0.018. Outside the ICU, 95% of drives and 75% of loans have records on both sides of a calendar cut, and the overlap gap persists under a calendar split. The audits show which features and preprocessing choices to check; the evaluation protocol decides the consequences. I release the code, a library that runs the audits on any table with a unit column and a time column, and a guide to using the audits.

title: Angular Interpolation in Sparse-View Low-Dose CT Reconstruction: Placement Effects and Data-Consistency Step-Size Scaling
summary: Dual-domain networks combine projection and image processing for sparse-view low-dose computed tomography (CT). We quantify the contribution of angular interpolation before learning and distinguish its roles in sinogram initialisation and the image residual base. On synthetic parallel-beam data, parameter-free interpolation reduces noise-free missing-view mean absolute error by 99.7% relative to zero filling at 60 views. Full-view filtered back-projection (FBP) of the jointly learned completed sinogram adds 1.27 dB of peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) over interpolated FBP. In a data-consistency dual-domain network (DC-DuNet), a 2x2 configuration ablation controls branch width, depth and training schedule while varying these placements and their associated input channels. After 20 epochs, the PSNR contrasts are +1.98 dB for sinogram initialisation and -2.16 dB for the interpolated image base; the image-base ranking also reverses during training. The sinogram-initialised variant exceeds an image-only U-Net by 0.96 dB at 60 views and 10% dose, and by 1.28 dB on independently generated synthetic data. The U-Net leads at higher view counts and with a shared interpolated image base. Without retraining, the variant retains a 0.12 dB advantage on held-out CHAOS abdominal CT under simulated degradation; the image-base contrast rounds to zero. The implemented projection/backprojection pair has empirical dominant gain of approximately 0.85NK, where N is image-grid width and K acquired view count. These results distinguish interpolation placement from network architecture and support NK normalisation for step calibration.

title: SMOTE 25 Years of Magic: What Has Been Done, What the Evidence Shows, and Whom It Reached
comment: 60 pages, 10 figures, 17 tables. The online appendix (55 pages) is an ancillary file. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24212321
summary: Background. SMOTE was published in this journal in 2002 and reviewed here at its fifteenth anniversary in 2018. At twenty-five it is cited by more than 34,000 indexed works, half of them outside computer science. Objectives. To establish what the methods built on SMOTE change, how strong the evidence for them is, and whom the technique has reached. Methods. We audited a curated corpus of 76 papers, 37 of which propose a SMOTE-family generator, and tested its coverage with a systematic search of 22,426 records in the PRISMA 2020 format. From the corpus we collected 1,756 dataset entries, 1,511 published comparisons with SMOTE and the evaluation design of 71 studies; from the search we drew 300 applications of SMOTE at random. We used an agentic AI approach to extract, screen and code under our written rules, and we report how each step was checked. Results. Every variant re-decides some of the six decisions of the SMOTE rule, and 24 of the 37 are only ever run on two classes. In their own papers, proposed methods beat SMOTE in 79.0% of the decided comparisons, but independent studies find that the gains shrink with strong learners and tuned thresholds, and that resampling damages calibration. The corpus holds 52 of the 3,097 records that pass the screen and covers the early years closely, the recent ones thinly. The reach is very wide, but a benefit at the level of outcomes is undemonstrated, four harms are documented, and an estimated 37% of applications resample the whole data set before splitting it. Conclusions. For tabular classification, a new SMOTE variant should no longer count as a contribution in itself: a new generator should be tested one decision at a time against class weighting and a tuned threshold with a strong learner, with calibration reported. We close with a selection guide, a reporting checklist of fifteen items and a research agenda.
